+// Each block owns a coalesced XY tile and a short Z slab.  XY neighbours are
+// served from shared memory while bottom/centre/top values advance through Z
+// in registers.  Two shared planes are ping-ponged so only one block-wide
+// synchronization is needed per output plane.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY, 4)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output, const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    __shared__ Real tile[2][kBlockY + 2][kBlockX + 2];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t x = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + tx + 1;
+    const size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + ty + 1;
+    const size_t zBegin = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZChunk + 1;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZChunk), nz - 1);
+    const size_t planeStride = nx * ny;
+
+    // Threads outside a partial edge tile still populate shared memory using
+    // clamped coordinates, allowing all threads to reach every barrier.
+    const size_t loadX = min(x, nx - 1);
+    const size_t loadY = min(y, ny - 1);
+    size_t centerIndex = zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + loadX;
+
+    Real center = input[centerIndex];
+    Real bottom = input[centerIndex - planeStride];
+    tile[0][ty + 1][tx + 1] = center;
+
+    if (tx == 0) {
+        tile[0][ty + 1][0] = input[centerIndex - 1];
+    }
+    if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {
+        const size_t rightX = min(x + 1, nx - 1);
+        tile[0][ty + 1][kBlockX + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + rightX];
+    }
+    if (ty == 0) {
+        tile[0][0][tx + 1] = input[centerIndex - nx];
+    }
+    if (ty == kBlockY - 1) {
+        const size_t backY = min(y + 1, ny - 1);
+        tile[0][kBlockY + 1][tx + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + backY * nx + loadX];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    int currentPlane = 0;
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+        const Real top = input[centerIndex + planeStride];
+
+        if (x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1) {
+            const Real left = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx];

+// Each block owns a coalesced XY tile and a short Z slab.  XY neighbours are
+// served from shared memory while bottom/centre/top values advance through Z
+// in registers.  Two shared planes are ping-ponged so only one block-wide
+// synchronization is needed per output plane.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY, 4)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output, const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    __shared__ Real tile[2][kBlockY + 2][kBlockX + 2];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t x = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + tx + 1;
+    const size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + ty + 1;
+    const size_t zBegin = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZChunk + 1;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZChunk), nz - 1);
+    const size_t planeStride = nx * ny;
+
+    // Threads outside a partial edge tile still populate shared memory using
+    // clamped coordinates, allowing all threads to reach every barrier.
+    const size_t loadX = min(x, nx - 1);
+    const size_t loadY = min(y, ny - 1);
+    size_t centerIndex = zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + loadX;
+
+    Real center = input[centerIndex];
+    Real bottom = input[centerIndex - planeStride];
+    tile[0][ty + 1][tx + 1] = center;
+
+    if (tx == 0) {
+        tile[0][ty + 1][0] = input[centerIndex - 1];
+    }
+    if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {
+        const size_t rightX = min(x + 1, nx - 1);
+        tile[0][ty + 1][kBlockX + 1] =

+    }
+    if (ty == 0) {

+    }
+    if (ty == kBlockY - 1) {

+        tile[0][kBlockY + 1][tx + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + backY * nx + loadX];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    int currentPlane = 0;
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+        const Real top = input[centerIndex + planeStride];
+
+        if (x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1) {
+            const Real left = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx];
+            const Real right = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx + 2];
+            const Real front = tile[currentPlane][ty][tx + 1];
+            const Real back = tile[currentPlane][ty + 2][tx + 1];

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY, 4)
+void naiveStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                        Real* __restrict__ output, const size_t nx,
+                        const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const size_t x = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX +
+                     threadIdx.x + 1;
+    const size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY +
+                     threadIdx.y + 1;
+    const size_t z = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) + 1;
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || z >= nz - 1) return;
+    const size_t planeStride = nx * ny;
+    const size_t index = z * planeStride + y * nx + x;
+    const Real center = input[index];
+    const Real left = input[index - 1];
+    const Real right = input[index + 1];
+    const Real front = input[index - nx];
+    const Real back = input[index + nx];
+    const Real bottom = input[index - planeStride];
+    const Real top = input[index + planeStride];
+    output[index] =
+        (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) / 7.0;
+}
+#endif

+// Each block owns a coalesced XY tile and a short Z slab.  XY neighbours are
+// served from shared memory while bottom/centre/top values advance through Z
+// in registers.  Two shared planes are ping-ponged so only one block-wide
+// synchronization is needed per output plane.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY, 4)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output, const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    __shared__ Real tile[2][kBlockY + 2][kBlockX + 2];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t x = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + tx + 1;
+    const size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + ty + 1;
+    const size_t zBegin = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZChunk + 1;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZChunk), nz - 1);
+    const size_t planeStride = nx * ny;
+
+    // Threads outside a partial edge tile still populate shared memory using
+    // clamped coordinates, allowing all threads to reach every barrier.
+    const size_t loadX = min(x, nx - 1);
+    const size_t loadY = min(y, ny - 1);
+    size_t centerIndex = zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + loadX;
+
+    Real center = input[centerIndex];
+    Real bottom = input[centerIndex - planeStride];
+    tile[0][ty + 1][tx + 1] = center;
+
+    if (tx == 0) {
+        tile[0][ty + 1][0] = input[centerIndex - 1];
+    }
+    if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {
+        const size_t rightX = min(x + 1, nx - 1);
+        tile[0][ty + 1][kBlockX + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + rightX];
+    }
+    if (ty == 0) {
+        tile[0][0][tx + 1] = input[centerIndex - nx];
+    }
+    if (ty == kBlockY - 1) {
+        const size_t backY = min(y + 1, ny - 1);
+        tile[0][kBlockY + 1][tx + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + backY * nx + loadX];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    int currentPlane = 0;
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+        const Real top = input[centerIndex + planeStride];
+

+// Each block owns a coalesced XY tile and a short Z slab.  XY neighbours are
+// served from shared memory while bottom/centre/top values advance through Z
+// in registers.  Two shared planes are ping-ponged so only one block-wide
+// synchronization is needed per output plane.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY, 4)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output, const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    __shared__ Real tile[2][kBlockY + 2][kBlockX + 2];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t x = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + tx + 1;
+    const size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + ty + 1;
+    const size_t zBegin = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZChunk + 1;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZChunk), nz - 1);
+    const size_t planeStride = nx * ny;
+
+    // Threads outside a partial edge tile still populate shared memory using
+    // clamped coordinates, allowing all threads to reach every barrier.
+    const size_t loadX = min(x, nx - 1);
+    const size_t loadY = min(y, ny - 1);
+    size_t centerIndex = zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + loadX;
+
+    Real center = input[centerIndex];
+    Real bottom = input[centerIndex - planeStride];
+    tile[0][ty + 1][tx + 1] = center;
+
+    if (tx == 0) {
+        tile[0][ty + 1][0] = input[centerIndex - 1];
+    }
+    if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {
+        const size_t rightX = min(x + 1, nx - 1);

+    }
+    if (ty == 0) {

+    }
+    if (ty == kBlockY - 1) {

+        tile[0][kBlockY + 1][tx + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + backY * nx + loadX];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    int currentPlane = 0;

+        const Real top = input[centerIndex + planeStride];
+
+        if (x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1) {
+            const Real left = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx];
+            const Real right = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx + 2];
+            const Real front = tile[currentPlane][ty][tx + 1];
+            const Real back = tile[currentPlane][ty + 2][tx + 1];

+void naiveStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,

+                        const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const size_t x = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX +
+                     threadIdx.x + 1;
+    const size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY +
+                     threadIdx.y + 1;
+    const size_t z = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) + 1;
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || z >= nz - 1) return;
+    const size_t planeStride = nx * ny;
+    const size_t index = z * planeStride + y * nx + x;
+    const Real center = input[index];
+    const Real left = input[index - 1];
+    const Real right = input[index + 1];
+    const Real front = input[index - nx];

+    const Real top = input[index + planeStride];

+// Each block owns a coalesced XY tile and a short Z slab.  XY neighbours are
+// served from shared memory while bottom/centre/top values advance through Z
+// in registers.  Two shared planes are ping-ponged so only one block-wide
+// synchronization is needed per output plane.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY, 4)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output, const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    __shared__ Real tile[2][kBlockY + 2][kBlockX + 2];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t x = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + tx + 1;
+    const size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + ty + 1;
+    const size_t zBegin = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZChunk + 1;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZChunk), nz - 1);
+    const size_t planeStride = nx * ny;
+
+    // Threads outside a partial edge tile still populate shared memory using
+    // clamped coordinates, allowing all threads to reach every barrier.
+    const size_t loadX = min(x, nx - 1);
+    const size_t loadY = min(y, ny - 1);
+    size_t centerIndex = zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + loadX;
+
+    Real center = input[centerIndex];
+    Real bottom = input[centerIndex - planeStride];
+    tile[0][ty + 1][tx + 1] = center;
+
+    if (tx == 0) {
+        tile[0][ty + 1][0] = input[centerIndex - 1];
+    }
+    if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {
+        const size_t rightX = min(x + 1, nx - 1);
+        tile[0][ty + 1][kBlockX + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + rightX];
+    }
+    if (ty == 0) {
+        tile[0][0][tx + 1] = input[centerIndex - nx];
+    }
+    if (ty == kBlockY - 1) {
+        const size_t backY = min(y + 1, ny - 1);
+        tile[0][kBlockY + 1][tx + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + backY * nx + loadX];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    int currentPlane = 0;
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+        const Real top = input[centerIndex + planeStride];
+
+        if (x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1) {
+            const Real left = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx];
+            const Real right = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx + 2];
+            const Real front = tile[currentPlane][ty][tx + 1];
+            const Real back = tile[currentPlane][ty + 2][tx + 1];
+            output[z * planeStride + y * nx + x] =

+void naiveStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,

+                        const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const size_t x = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX +
+                     threadIdx.x + 1;
+    const size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY +

+    const Real left = input[index - 1];
+    const Real right = input[index + 1];

+// Each block owns a coalesced XY tile and a short Z slab.  XY neighbours are
+// served from shared memory while bottom/centre/top values advance through Z
+// in registers.  Two shared planes are ping-ponged so only one block-wide
+// synchronization is needed per output plane.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY, 4)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output, const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    __shared__ Real tile[2][kBlockY + 2][kBlockX + 2];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t x = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + tx + 1;
+    const size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + ty + 1;
+    const size_t zBegin = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZChunk + 1;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZChunk), nz - 1);
+    const size_t planeStride = nx * ny;
+
+    // Threads outside a partial edge tile still populate shared memory using
+    // clamped coordinates, allowing all threads to reach every barrier.
+    const size_t loadX = min(x, nx - 1);
+    const size_t loadY = min(y, ny - 1);
+    size_t centerIndex = zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + loadX;
+
+    Real center = input[centerIndex];
+    Real bottom = input[centerIndex - planeStride];
+    tile[0][ty + 1][tx + 1] = center;
+
+    if (tx == 0) {
+        tile[0][ty + 1][0] = input[centerIndex - 1];
+    }
+    if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {
+        const size_t rightX = min(x + 1, nx - 1);
+        tile[0][ty + 1][kBlockX + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + rightX];
+    }
+    if (ty == 0) {
+        tile[0][0][tx + 1] = input[centerIndex - nx];
+    }
+    if (ty == kBlockY - 1) {
+        const size_t backY = min(y + 1, ny - 1);
+        tile[0][kBlockY + 1][tx + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + backY * nx + loadX];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    int currentPlane = 0;
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+        const Real top = input[centerIndex + planeStride];
+
+        if (x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1) {
+            const Real left = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx];
+            const Real right = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx + 2];
+            const Real front = tile[currentPlane][ty][tx + 1];
+            const Real back = tile[currentPlane][ty + 2][tx + 1];
+            output[z * planeStride + y * nx + x] =
+                (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) / 7.0;
+        }
+
+        if (z + 1 < zEnd) {
+            const int nextPlane = currentPlane ^ 1;
+            const size_t nextIndex = centerIndex + planeStride;
+            tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][tx + 1] = top;
+

+// Each block owns a coalesced XY tile and a short Z slab.  XY neighbours are
+// served from shared memory while bottom/centre/top values advance through Z
+// in registers.  Two shared planes are ping-ponged so only one block-wide
+// synchronization is needed per output plane.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY, 4)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output, const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY, 4)
+void naiveStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                        Real* __restrict__ output, const size_t nx,
+                        const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const size_t x = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX +
+                     threadIdx.x + 1;
+    const size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY +
+                     threadIdx.y + 1;
+    const size_t z = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) + 1;
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || z >= nz - 1) return;
+    const size_t planeStride = nx * ny;
+    const size_t index = z * planeStride + y * nx + x;
+    const Real center = input[index];
+    const Real left = input[index - 1];
+    const Real right = input[index + 1];
+    const Real front = input[index - nx];
+    const Real back = input[index + nx];
+    const Real bottom = input[index - planeStride];
+    const Real top = input[index + planeStride];
+    output[index] =
+        (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) / 7.0;
+}
+#endif
+
+// Each block owns a coalesced XY tile and a short Z slab.  XY neighbours are
+// served from shared memory while bottom/centre/top values advance through Z
+// in registers.  Two shared planes are ping-ponged so only one block-wide
+// synchronization is needed per output plane.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY, 4)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output, const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    __shared__ Real tile[2][kBlockY + 2][kBlockX + 2];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t x = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + tx + 1;
+    const size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + ty + 1;
+    const size_t zBegin = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZChunk + 1;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZChunk), nz - 1);
+    const size_t planeStride = nx * ny;
+
+    // Threads outside a partial edge tile still populate shared memory using
+    // clamped coordinates, allowing all threads to reach every barrier.
+    const size_t loadX = min(x, nx - 1);
+    const size_t loadY = min(y, ny - 1);
+    size_t centerIndex = zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + loadX;
+
+    Real center = input[centerIndex];
+    Real bottom = input[centerIndex - planeStride];
+    tile[0][ty + 1][tx + 1] = center;
+
+    if (tx == 0) {
+        tile[0][ty + 1][0] = input[centerIndex - 1];
+    }
+    if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {
+        const size_t rightX = min(x + 1, nx - 1);
+        tile[0][ty + 1][kBlockX + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + rightX];
+    }
+    if (ty == 0) {
+        tile[0][0][tx + 1] = input[centerIndex - nx];
+    }
+    if (ty == kBlockY - 1) {
+        const size_t backY = min(y + 1, ny - 1);
+        tile[0][kBlockY + 1][tx + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + backY * nx + loadX];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    int currentPlane = 0;
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+        const Real top = input[centerIndex + planeStride];
+
+        if (x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1) {
+            const Real left = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx];
+            const Real right = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx + 2];
+            const Real front = tile[currentPlane][ty][tx + 1];
+            const Real back = tile[currentPlane][ty + 2][tx + 1];
+            output[z * planeStride + y * nx + x] =
+                (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) / 7.0;
+        }
+
+        if (z + 1 < zEnd) {
+            const int nextPlane = currentPlane ^ 1;
+            const size_t nextIndex = centerIndex + planeStride;
+            tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][tx + 1] = top;
+
+            if (tx == 0) {
+                tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][0] = input[nextIndex - 1];
+            }
+            if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {

+// Each block owns a coalesced XY tile and a short Z slab.  XY neighbours are
+// served from shared memory while bottom/centre/top values advance through Z
+// in registers.  Two shared planes are ping-ponged so only one block-wide
+// synchronization is needed per output plane.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY, 4)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output, const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {

+// Each block owns a coalesced XY tile and a short Z slab.  XY neighbours are
+// served from shared memory while bottom/centre/top values advance through Z
+// in registers.  Two shared planes are ping-ponged so only one block-wide
+// synchronization is needed per output plane.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY, 4)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output, const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {

+// Each block owns a coalesced XY tile and a short Z slab.  XY neighbours are
+// served from shared memory while bottom/centre/top values advance through Z
+// in registers.  Two shared planes are ping-ponged so only one block-wide
+// synchronization is needed per output plane.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY, 4)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output, const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {

+

+    const size_t zBegin = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZChunk + 1;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZChunk), nz - 1);
+    const size_t planeStride = nx * ny;

+    // clamped coordinates, allowing all threads to reach every barrier.

+    }
+    if (ty == kBlockY - 1) {

+        tile[0][kBlockY + 1][tx + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + backY * nx + loadX];

+        const Real top = input[centerIndex + planeStride];

+void naiveStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,

+                        const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const size_t x = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX +
+                     threadIdx.x + 1;
+    const size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY +

+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || z >= nz - 1) return;

+    const size_t index = z * planeStride + y * nx + x;

+    const Real left = input[index - 1];

+// Each block owns a coalesced XY tile and a short Z slab.  XY neighbours are
+// served from shared memory while bottom/centre/top values advance through Z
+// in registers.  Two shared planes are ping-ponged so only one block-wide
+// synchronization is needed per output plane.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY, 4)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output, const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    __shared__ Real tile[2][kBlockY + 2][kBlockX + 2];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t x = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + tx + 1;
+    const size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + ty + 1;
+    const size_t zBegin = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZChunk + 1;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZChunk), nz - 1);
+    const size_t planeStride = nx * ny;
+
+    // Threads outside a partial edge tile still populate shared memory using
+    // clamped coordinates, allowing all threads to reach every barrier.
+    const size_t loadX = min(x, nx - 1);
+    const size_t loadY = min(y, ny - 1);
+    size_t centerIndex = zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + loadX;
+
+    Real center = input[centerIndex];
+    Real bottom = input[centerIndex - planeStride];
+    tile[0][ty + 1][tx + 1] = center;
+
+    if (tx == 0) {
+        tile[0][ty + 1][0] = input[centerIndex - 1];
+    }
+    if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {
+        const size_t rightX = min(x + 1, nx - 1);
+        tile[0][ty + 1][kBlockX + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + rightX];
+    }
+    if (ty == 0) {
+        tile[0][0][tx + 1] = input[centerIndex - nx];
+    }
+    if (ty == kBlockY - 1) {
+        const size_t backY = min(y + 1, ny - 1);
+        tile[0][kBlockY + 1][tx + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + backY * nx + loadX];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    int currentPlane = 0;
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+        const Real top = input[centerIndex + planeStride];
+
+        if (x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1) {
+            const Real left = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx];
+            const Real right = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx + 2];
+            const Real front = tile[currentPlane][ty][tx + 1];
+            const Real back = tile[currentPlane][ty + 2][tx + 1];
+            output[z * planeStride + y * nx + x] =
+                (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) / 7.0;
+        }
+
+        if (z + 1 < zEnd) {
+            const int nextPlane = currentPlane ^ 1;
+            const size_t nextIndex = centerIndex + planeStride;
+            tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][tx + 1] = top;
+
+            if (tx == 0) {
+                tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][0] = input[nextIndex - 1];
+            }
+            if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {

+void naiveStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,

+                        const KernelIndex ny, const KernelIndex nz) {
+    const KernelIndex x = static_cast<KernelIndex>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX +
+                          threadIdx.x + 1;

+// Each block owns a coalesced XY tile and a short Z slab.  XY neighbours are
+// served from shared memory while bottom/centre/top values advance through Z
+// in registers.  Two shared planes are ping-ponged so only one block-wide
+// synchronization is needed per output plane.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY, 4)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output, const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    __shared__ Real tile[2][kBlockY + 2][kBlockX + 2];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t x = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + tx + 1;
+    const size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + ty + 1;
+    const size_t zBegin = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZChunk + 1;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZChunk), nz - 1);
+    const size_t planeStride = nx * ny;
+
+    // Threads outside a partial edge tile still populate shared memory using
+    // clamped coordinates, allowing all threads to reach every barrier.
+    const size_t loadX = min(x, nx - 1);
+    const size_t loadY = min(y, ny - 1);
+    size_t centerIndex = zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + loadX;
+
+    Real center = input[centerIndex];
+    Real bottom = input[centerIndex - planeStride];
+    tile[0][ty + 1][tx + 1] = center;
+
+    if (tx == 0) {
+        tile[0][ty + 1][0] = input[centerIndex - 1];
+    }
+    if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {
+        const size_t rightX = min(x + 1, nx - 1);
+        tile[0][ty + 1][kBlockX + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + rightX];
+    }
+    if (ty == 0) {
+        tile[0][0][tx + 1] = input[centerIndex - nx];
+    }
+    if (ty == kBlockY - 1) {
+        const size_t backY = min(y + 1, ny - 1);
+        tile[0][kBlockY + 1][tx + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + backY * nx + loadX];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    int currentPlane = 0;
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+        const Real top = input[centerIndex + planeStride];
+
+        if (x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1) {
+            const Real left = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx];
+            const Real right = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx + 2];
+            const Real front = tile[currentPlane][ty][tx + 1];
+            const Real back = tile[currentPlane][ty + 2][tx + 1];
+            output[z * planeStride + y * nx + x] =
+                (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) / 7.0;
+        }
+
+        if (z + 1 < zEnd) {
+            const int nextPlane = currentPlane ^ 1;
+            const size_t nextIndex = centerIndex + planeStride;
+            tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][tx + 1] = top;
+
+            if (tx == 0) {
+                tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][0] = input[nextIndex - 1];
+            }
+            if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {
+                const size_t rightX = min(x + 1, nx - 1);
+                tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][kBlockX + 1] =
+                    input[(z + 1) * planeStride + loadY * nx + rightX];
+            }
+            if (ty == 0) {
+                tile[nextPlane][0][tx + 1] = input[nextIndex - nx];
+            }
+            if (ty == kBlockY - 1) {
+                const size_t backY = min(y + 1, ny - 1);
+                tile[nextPlane][kBlockY + 1][tx + 1] =
+                    input[(z + 1) * planeStride + backY * nx + loadX];
             }
+            __syncthreads();
+
+            bottom = center;
+            center = top;
+            centerIndex = nextIndex;
+            currentPlane = nextPlane;
         }
     }
 }

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY, 4)
+void naiveStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                        Real* __restrict__ output, const KernelIndex nx,
+                        const KernelIndex ny, const KernelIndex nz) {
+    const KernelIndex x = static_cast<KernelIndex>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX +
+                          threadIdx.x + 1;
+    const KernelIndex y = static_cast<KernelIndex>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY +
+                          threadIdx.y + 1;

+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || z >= nz - 1) return;

+    const KernelIndex index = z * planeStride + y * nx + x;
+    const Real center = input[index];
+    const Real left = input[index - 1];
+    const Real right = input[index + 1];

+    output[index] =

+#endif

+// Each block owns a coalesced XY tile and a short Z slab.  XY neighbours are
+// served from shared memory while bottom/centre/top values advance through Z
+// in registers.  Two shared planes are ping-ponged so only one block-wide
+// synchronization is needed per output plane.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY, 4)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output, const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    __shared__ Real tile[2][kBlockY + 2][kBlockX + 2];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t x = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + tx + 1;
+    const size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + ty + 1;
+    const size_t zBegin = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZChunk + 1;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZChunk), nz - 1);
+    const size_t planeStride = nx * ny;
+
+    // Threads outside a partial edge tile still populate shared memory using
+    // clamped coordinates, allowing all threads to reach every barrier.
+    const size_t loadX = min(x, nx - 1);
+    const size_t loadY = min(y, ny - 1);
+    size_t centerIndex = zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + loadX;
+
+    Real center = input[centerIndex];
+    Real bottom = input[centerIndex - planeStride];
+    tile[0][ty + 1][tx + 1] = center;
+
+    if (tx == 0) {
+        tile[0][ty + 1][0] = input[centerIndex - 1];
+    }
+    if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {
+        const size_t rightX = min(x + 1, nx - 1);
+        tile[0][ty + 1][kBlockX + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + rightX];
+    }
+    if (ty == 0) {
+        tile[0][0][tx + 1] = input[centerIndex - nx];
+    }
+    if (ty == kBlockY - 1) {
+        const size_t backY = min(y + 1, ny - 1);
+        tile[0][kBlockY + 1][tx + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + backY * nx + loadX];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    int currentPlane = 0;
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+        const Real top = input[centerIndex + planeStride];
+
+        if (x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1) {
+            const Real left = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx];
+            const Real right = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx + 2];
+            const Real front = tile[currentPlane][ty][tx + 1];
+            const Real back = tile[currentPlane][ty + 2][tx + 1];
+            output[z * planeStride + y * nx + x] =
+                (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) / 7.0;
+        }
+
+        if (z + 1 < zEnd) {
+            const int nextPlane = currentPlane ^ 1;
+            const size_t nextIndex = centerIndex + planeStride;
+            tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][tx + 1] = top;
+
+            if (tx == 0) {
+                tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][0] = input[nextIndex - 1];
+            }
+            if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {
+                const size_t rightX = min(x + 1, nx - 1);
+                tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][kBlockX + 1] =
+                    input[(z + 1) * planeStride + loadY * nx + rightX];
+            }
+            if (ty == 0) {
+                tile[nextPlane][0][tx + 1] = input[nextIndex - nx];
+            }
+            if (ty == kBlockY - 1) {
+                const size_t backY = min(y + 1, ny - 1);
+                tile[nextPlane][kBlockY + 1][tx + 1] =
+                    input[(z + 1) * planeStride + backY * nx + loadX];
             }
+            __syncthreads();
+
+            bottom = center;
+            center = top;
+            centerIndex = nextIndex;
+            currentPlane = nextPlane;
         }
     }
 }

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY, 4)
+void naiveStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                        Real* __restrict__ output, const KernelIndex nx,
+                        const KernelIndex ny, const KernelIndex nz) {
+    const KernelIndex x = static_cast<KernelIndex>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX +
+                          threadIdx.x + 1;
+    const KernelIndex y = static_cast<KernelIndex>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY +
+                          threadIdx.y + 1;

+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || z >= nz - 1) return;
+    const KernelIndex planeStride = nx * ny;
+    const KernelIndex index = z * planeStride + y * nx + x;
+    const Real center = input[index];
+    const Real left = input[index - 1];
+    const Real right = input[index + 1];

+    const Real bottom = input[index - planeStride];
+    const Real top = input[index + planeStride];
+    output[index] =

+#endif

+// Each block owns a coalesced XY tile and a short Z slab.  XY neighbours are
+// served from shared memory while bottom/centre/top values advance through Z
+// in registers.  Two shared planes are ping-ponged so only one block-wide
+// synchronization is needed per output plane.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY, 4)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output, const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    __shared__ Real tile[2][kBlockY + 2][kBlockX + 2];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t x = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + tx + 1;
+    const size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + ty + 1;
+    const size_t zBegin = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZChunk + 1;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZChunk), nz - 1);
+    const size_t planeStride = nx * ny;
+
+    // Threads outside a partial edge tile still populate shared memory using
+    // clamped coordinates, allowing all threads to reach every barrier.
+    const size_t loadX = min(x, nx - 1);
+    const size_t loadY = min(y, ny - 1);
+    size_t centerIndex = zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + loadX;
+
+    Real center = input[centerIndex];
+    Real bottom = input[centerIndex - planeStride];
+    tile[0][ty + 1][tx + 1] = center;
+
+    if (tx == 0) {
+        tile[0][ty + 1][0] = input[centerIndex - 1];
+    }
+    if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {
+        const size_t rightX = min(x + 1, nx - 1);
+        tile[0][ty + 1][kBlockX + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + rightX];
+    }
+    if (ty == 0) {
+        tile[0][0][tx + 1] = input[centerIndex - nx];
+    }
+    if (ty == kBlockY - 1) {
+        const size_t backY = min(y + 1, ny - 1);
+        tile[0][kBlockY + 1][tx + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + backY * nx + loadX];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    int currentPlane = 0;
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+        const Real top = input[centerIndex + planeStride];
+
+        if (x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1) {
+            const Real left = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx];
+            const Real right = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx + 2];
+            const Real front = tile[currentPlane][ty][tx + 1];
+            const Real back = tile[currentPlane][ty + 2][tx + 1];
+            output[z * planeStride + y * nx + x] =
+                (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) / 7.0;
+        }
+
+        if (z + 1 < zEnd) {
+            const int nextPlane = currentPlane ^ 1;
+            const size_t nextIndex = centerIndex + planeStride;
+            tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][tx + 1] = top;
+
+            if (tx == 0) {
+                tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][0] = input[nextIndex - 1];
+            }
+            if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {
+                const size_t rightX = min(x + 1, nx - 1);
+                tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][kBlockX + 1] =
+                    input[(z + 1) * planeStride + loadY * nx + rightX];
+            }
+            if (ty == 0) {
+                tile[nextPlane][0][tx + 1] = input[nextIndex - nx];
+            }
+            if (ty == kBlockY - 1) {
+                const size_t backY = min(y + 1, ny - 1);
+                tile[nextPlane][kBlockY + 1][tx + 1] =
+                    input[(z + 1) * planeStride + backY * nx + loadX];
             }
+            __syncthreads();
+
+            bottom = center;
+            center = top;
+            centerIndex = nextIndex;
+            currentPlane = nextPlane;
         }
     }
 }

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY, 4)
+void naiveStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                        Real* __restrict__ output, const KernelIndex nx,
+                        const KernelIndex ny, const KernelIndex nz) {
+    const KernelIndex x = static_cast<KernelIndex>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX +
+                          threadIdx.x + 1;
+    const KernelIndex y = static_cast<KernelIndex>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY +
+                          threadIdx.y + 1;

+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || z >= nz - 1) return;
+    const KernelIndex planeStride = nx * ny;
+    const KernelIndex index = z * planeStride + y * nx + x;
+    const Real center = input[index];
+    const Real left = input[index - 1];
+    const Real right = input[index + 1];

+// Each block owns a coalesced XY tile and a short Z slab.  XY neighbours are
+// served from shared memory while bottom/centre/top values advance through Z
+// in registers.  Two shared planes are ping-ponged so only one block-wide
+// synchronization is needed per output plane.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY, 4)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output, const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    __shared__ Real tile[2][kBlockY + 2][kBlockX + 2];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t x = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + tx + 1;
+    const size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + ty + 1;
+    const size_t zBegin = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZChunk + 1;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZChunk), nz - 1);
+    const size_t planeStride = nx * ny;
+
+    // Threads outside a partial edge tile still populate shared memory using
+    // clamped coordinates, allowing all threads to reach every barrier.
+    const size_t loadX = min(x, nx - 1);
+    const size_t loadY = min(y, ny - 1);
+    size_t centerIndex = zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + loadX;
+
+    Real center = input[centerIndex];
+    Real bottom = input[centerIndex - planeStride];
+    tile[0][ty + 1][tx + 1] = center;
+
+    if (tx == 0) {
+        tile[0][ty + 1][0] = input[centerIndex - 1];
+    }
+    if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {
+        const size_t rightX = min(x + 1, nx - 1);
+        tile[0][ty + 1][kBlockX + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + rightX];
+    }
+    if (ty == 0) {
+        tile[0][0][tx + 1] = input[centerIndex - nx];
+    }
+    if (ty == kBlockY - 1) {
+        const size_t backY = min(y + 1, ny - 1);
+        tile[0][kBlockY + 1][tx + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + backY * nx + loadX];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    int currentPlane = 0;
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+        const Real top = input[centerIndex + planeStride];
+
+        if (x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1) {
+            const Real left = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx];
+            const Real right = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx + 2];
+            const Real front = tile[currentPlane][ty][tx + 1];
+            const Real back = tile[currentPlane][ty + 2][tx + 1];
+            output[z * planeStride + y * nx + x] =
+                (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) / 7.0;
+        }
+
+        if (z + 1 < zEnd) {
+            const int nextPlane = currentPlane ^ 1;
+            const size_t nextIndex = centerIndex + planeStride;
+            tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][tx + 1] = top;
+
+            if (tx == 0) {
+                tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][0] = input[nextIndex - 1];
+            }
+            if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {
+                const size_t rightX = min(x + 1, nx - 1);
+                tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][kBlockX + 1] =
+                    input[(z + 1) * planeStride + loadY * nx + rightX];
+            }
+            if (ty == 0) {
+                tile[nextPlane][0][tx + 1] = input[nextIndex - nx];
+            }
+            if (ty == kBlockY - 1) {
+                const size_t backY = min(y + 1, ny - 1);
+                tile[nextPlane][kBlockY + 1][tx + 1] =
+                    input[(z + 1) * planeStride + backY * nx + loadX];
             }
+            __syncthreads();
+
+            bottom = center;
+            center = top;
+            centerIndex = nextIndex;
+            currentPlane = nextPlane;
         }
     }
 }

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY, 4)
+void naiveStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                        Real* __restrict__ output, const KernelIndex nx,
+                        const KernelIndex ny, const KernelIndex nz) {
+    const KernelIndex x = static_cast<KernelIndex>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX +
+                          threadIdx.x + 1;

+// Each block owns a coalesced XY tile and a short Z slab.  XY neighbours are
+// served from shared memory while bottom/centre/top values advance through Z
+// in registers.  Two shared planes are ping-ponged so only one block-wide
+// synchronization is needed per output plane.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY, 4)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output, const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    __shared__ Real tile[2][kBlockY + 2][kBlockX + 2];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t x = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + tx + 1;
+    const size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + ty + 1;
+    const size_t zBegin = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZChunk + 1;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZChunk), nz - 1);
+    const size_t planeStride = nx * ny;
+
+    // Threads outside a partial edge tile still populate shared memory using
+    // clamped coordinates, allowing all threads to reach every barrier.
+    const size_t loadX = min(x, nx - 1);
+    const size_t loadY = min(y, ny - 1);
+    size_t centerIndex = zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + loadX;
+
+    Real center = input[centerIndex];
+    Real bottom = input[centerIndex - planeStride];
+    tile[0][ty + 1][tx + 1] = center;
+
+    if (tx == 0) {
+        tile[0][ty + 1][0] = input[centerIndex - 1];
+    }
+    if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {
+        const size_t rightX = min(x + 1, nx - 1);
+        tile[0][ty + 1][kBlockX + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + rightX];
+    }
+    if (ty == 0) {
+        tile[0][0][tx + 1] = input[centerIndex - nx];
+    }
+    if (ty == kBlockY - 1) {
+        const size_t backY = min(y + 1, ny - 1);
+        tile[0][kBlockY + 1][tx + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + backY * nx + loadX];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    int currentPlane = 0;
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+        const Real top = input[centerIndex + planeStride];
+
+        if (x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1) {
+            const Real left = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx];
+            const Real right = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx + 2];
+            const Real front = tile[currentPlane][ty][tx + 1];
+            const Real back = tile[currentPlane][ty + 2][tx + 1];
+            output[z * planeStride + y * nx + x] =
+                (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) / 7.0;
+        }
+
+        if (z + 1 < zEnd) {
+            const int nextPlane = currentPlane ^ 1;
+            const size_t nextIndex = centerIndex + planeStride;
+            tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][tx + 1] = top;
+
+            if (tx == 0) {
+                tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][0] = input[nextIndex - 1];
+            }
+            if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {
+                const size_t rightX = min(x + 1, nx - 1);
+                tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][kBlockX + 1] =
+                    input[(z + 1) * planeStride + loadY * nx + rightX];
+            }
+            if (ty == 0) {
+                tile[nextPlane][0][tx + 1] = input[nextIndex - nx];
+            }
+            if (ty == kBlockY - 1) {
+                const size_t backY = min(y + 1, ny - 1);
+                tile[nextPlane][kBlockY + 1][tx + 1] =
+                    input[(z + 1) * planeStride + backY * nx + loadX];
             }
+            __syncthreads();
+
+            bottom = center;
+            center = top;
+            centerIndex = nextIndex;
+            currentPlane = nextPlane;
         }
     }
 }

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY, 4)
+void naiveStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                        Real* __restrict__ output, const KernelIndex nx,
+                        const KernelIndex ny, const KernelIndex nz) {
+    const KernelIndex x = static_cast<KernelIndex>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX +
+                          threadIdx.x + 1;

+// Each block owns a coalesced XY tile and a short Z slab.  XY neighbours are
+// served from shared memory while bottom/centre/top values advance through Z
+// in registers.  Two shared planes are ping-ponged so only one block-wide
+// synchronization is needed per output plane.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY, 4)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output, const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    __shared__ Real tile[2][kBlockY + 2][kBlockX + 2];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t x = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + tx + 1;
+    const size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + ty + 1;
+    const size_t zBegin = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZChunk + 1;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZChunk), nz - 1);
+    const size_t planeStride = nx * ny;
+
+    // Threads outside a partial edge tile still populate shared memory using
+    // clamped coordinates, allowing all threads to reach every barrier.
+    const size_t loadX = min(x, nx - 1);
+    const size_t loadY = min(y, ny - 1);
+    size_t centerIndex = zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + loadX;
+
+    Real center = input[centerIndex];
+    Real bottom = input[centerIndex - planeStride];
+    tile[0][ty + 1][tx + 1] = center;
+
+    if (tx == 0) {
+        tile[0][ty + 1][0] = input[centerIndex - 1];
+    }
+    if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {
+        const size_t rightX = min(x + 1, nx - 1);
+        tile[0][ty + 1][kBlockX + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + rightX];
+    }
+    if (ty == 0) {
+        tile[0][0][tx + 1] = input[centerIndex - nx];
+    }
+    if (ty == kBlockY - 1) {
+        const size_t backY = min(y + 1, ny - 1);
+        tile[0][kBlockY + 1][tx + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + backY * nx + loadX];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    int currentPlane = 0;
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+        const Real top = input[centerIndex + planeStride];
+
+        if (x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1) {
+            const Real left = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx];
+            const Real right = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx + 2];
+            const Real front = tile[currentPlane][ty][tx + 1];
+            const Real back = tile[currentPlane][ty + 2][tx + 1];
+            output[z * planeStride + y * nx + x] =

+// Each block owns a coalesced XY tile and a short Z slab.  XY neighbours are
+// served from shared memory while bottom/centre/top values advance through Z
+// in registers.  Two shared planes are ping-ponged so only one block-wide
+// synchronization is needed per output plane.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY, 4)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output, const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    __shared__ Real tile[2][kBlockY + 2][kBlockX + 2];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t x = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + tx + 1;
+    const size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + ty + 1;
+    const size_t zBegin = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZChunk + 1;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZChunk), nz - 1);
+    const size_t planeStride = nx * ny;
+
+    // Threads outside a partial edge tile still populate shared memory using
+    // clamped coordinates, allowing all threads to reach every barrier.
+    const size_t loadX = min(x, nx - 1);
+    const size_t loadY = min(y, ny - 1);
+    size_t centerIndex = zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + loadX;
+
+    Real center = input[centerIndex];
+    Real bottom = input[centerIndex - planeStride];
+    tile[0][ty + 1][tx + 1] = center;
+
+    if (tx == 0) {
+        tile[0][ty + 1][0] = input[centerIndex - 1];
+    }
+    if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {
+        const size_t rightX = min(x + 1, nx - 1);
+        tile[0][ty + 1][kBlockX + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + rightX];
+    }

+    }

+    int currentPlane = 0;
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+        const Real top = input[centerIndex + planeStride];
+
+        if (x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1) {
+            const Real left = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx];
+            const Real right = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx + 2];
+            const Real front = tile[currentPlane][ty][tx + 1];
+            const Real back = tile[currentPlane][ty + 2][tx + 1];
+            output[z * planeStride + y * nx + x] =
+                (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) / 7.0;
+        }

+        if (z + 1 < zEnd) {
+            const int nextPlane = currentPlane ^ 1;
+            const size_t nextIndex = centerIndex + planeStride;
+            tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][tx + 1] = top;
+
+            if (tx == 0) {
+                tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][0] = input[nextIndex - 1];
+            }
+            if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {
+                const size_t rightX = min(x + 1, nx - 1);

+            }
+            if (ty == 0) {

+            }
+            if (ty == kBlockY - 1) {
+                const size_t backY = min(y + 1, ny - 1);
+                tile[nextPlane][kBlockY + 1][tx + 1] =
+                    input[(z + 1) * planeStride + backY * nx + loadX];
             }
+            __syncthreads();
+
+            bottom = center;
+            center = top;
+            centerIndex = nextIndex;
+            currentPlane = nextPlane;
         }
     }

+    const KernelIndex x = static_cast<KernelIndex>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX +

+// Each block owns a coalesced XY tile and a short Z slab.  XY neighbours are
+// served from shared memory while bottom/centre/top values advance through Z
+// in registers.  Two shared planes are ping-ponged so only one block-wide
+// synchronization is needed per output plane.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY, 4)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output, const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    __shared__ Real tile[2][kBlockY + 2][kBlockX + 2];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t x = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + tx + 1;
+    const size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + ty + 1;
+    const size_t zBegin = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZChunk + 1;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZChunk), nz - 1);
+    const size_t planeStride = nx * ny;
+
+    // Threads outside a partial edge tile still populate shared memory using
+    // clamped coordinates, allowing all threads to reach every barrier.
+    const size_t loadX = min(x, nx - 1);
+    const size_t loadY = min(y, ny - 1);
+    size_t centerIndex = zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + loadX;
+
+    Real center = input[centerIndex];
+    Real bottom = input[centerIndex - planeStride];
+    tile[0][ty + 1][tx + 1] = center;
+
+    if (tx == 0) {
+        tile[0][ty + 1][0] = input[centerIndex - 1];
+    }
+    if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {
+        const size_t rightX = min(x + 1, nx - 1);
+        tile[0][ty + 1][kBlockX + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + rightX];
+    }
+    if (ty == 0) {
+        tile[0][0][tx + 1] = input[centerIndex - nx];
+    }
+    if (ty == kBlockY - 1) {
+        const size_t backY = min(y + 1, ny - 1);
+        tile[0][kBlockY + 1][tx + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + backY * nx + loadX];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    int currentPlane = 0;
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+        const Real top = input[centerIndex + planeStride];
+
+        if (x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1) {
+            const Real left = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx];
+            const Real right = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx + 2];
+            const Real front = tile[currentPlane][ty][tx + 1];
+            const Real back = tile[currentPlane][ty + 2][tx + 1];
+            output[z * planeStride + y * nx + x] =
+                (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) / 7.0;
+        }
+
+        if (z + 1 < zEnd) {
+            const int nextPlane = currentPlane ^ 1;
+            const size_t nextIndex = centerIndex + planeStride;
+            tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][tx + 1] = top;
+
+            if (tx == 0) {
+                tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][0] = input[nextIndex - 1];
             }
+            if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {
+                const size_t rightX = min(x + 1, nx - 1);
+                tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][kBlockX + 1] =
+                    input[(z + 1) * planeStride + loadY * nx + rightX];
+            }
+            if (ty == 0) {
+                tile[nextPlane][0][tx + 1] = input[nextIndex - nx];
+            }
+            if (ty == kBlockY - 1) {
+                const size_t backY = min(y + 1, ny - 1);
+                tile[nextPlane][kBlockY + 1][tx + 1] =
+                    input[(z + 1) * planeStride + backY * nx + loadX];
+            }
+            __syncthreads();
+
+            bottom = center;
+            center = top;
+            centerIndex = nextIndex;
+            currentPlane = nextPlane;
         }
     }
 }

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY, 4)
+void naiveStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,

+                        const KernelIndex ny, const KernelIndex nz) {
+    const KernelIndex x = static_cast<KernelIndex>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX +
+                          threadIdx.x + 1;

+// Each block owns a coalesced XY tile and a short Z slab.  XY neighbours are
+// served from shared memory while bottom/centre/top values advance through Z
+// in registers.  Two shared planes are ping-ponged so only one block-wide
+// synchronization is needed per output plane.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY, 4)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output, const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    __shared__ Real tile[2][kBlockY + 2][kBlockX + 2];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t x = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + tx + 1;
+    const size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + ty + 1;
+    const size_t zBegin = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZChunk + 1;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZChunk), nz - 1);
+    const size_t planeStride = nx * ny;
+
+    // Threads outside a partial edge tile still populate shared memory using
+    // clamped coordinates, allowing all threads to reach every barrier.
+    const size_t loadX = min(x, nx - 1);
+    const size_t loadY = min(y, ny - 1);
+    size_t centerIndex = zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + loadX;
+
+    Real center = input[centerIndex];
+    Real bottom = input[centerIndex - planeStride];
+    tile[0][ty + 1][tx + 1] = center;
+
+    if (tx == 0) {
+        tile[0][ty + 1][0] = input[centerIndex - 1];
+    }
+    if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {
+        const size_t rightX = min(x + 1, nx - 1);
+        tile[0][ty + 1][kBlockX + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + rightX];
+    }
+    if (ty == 0) {
+        tile[0][0][tx + 1] = input[centerIndex - nx];
+    }
+    if (ty == kBlockY - 1) {
+        const size_t backY = min(y + 1, ny - 1);
+        tile[0][kBlockY + 1][tx + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + backY * nx + loadX];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    int currentPlane = 0;
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+        const Real top = input[centerIndex + planeStride];
+
+        if (x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1) {
+            const Real left = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx];
+            const Real right = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx + 2];
+            const Real front = tile[currentPlane][ty][tx + 1];
+            const Real back = tile[currentPlane][ty + 2][tx + 1];
+            output[z * planeStride + y * nx + x] =
+                (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) / 7.0;
+        }
+
+        if (z + 1 < zEnd) {
+            const int nextPlane = currentPlane ^ 1;
+            const size_t nextIndex = centerIndex + planeStride;
+            tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][tx + 1] = top;
+
+            if (tx == 0) {
+                tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][0] = input[nextIndex - 1];
             }
+            if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {
+                const size_t rightX = min(x + 1, nx - 1);
+                tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][kBlockX + 1] =
+                    input[(z + 1) * planeStride + loadY * nx + rightX];
+            }
+            if (ty == 0) {
+                tile[nextPlane][0][tx + 1] = input[nextIndex - nx];
+            }
+            if (ty == kBlockY - 1) {
+                const size_t backY = min(y + 1, ny - 1);
+                tile[nextPlane][kBlockY + 1][tx + 1] =
+                    input[(z + 1) * planeStride + backY * nx + loadX];
+            }
+            __syncthreads();
+
+            bottom = center;
+            center = top;
+            centerIndex = nextIndex;
+            currentPlane = nextPlane;
         }
     }
 }

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY, 4)
+void naiveStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                        Real* __restrict__ output, const KernelIndex nx,
+                        const KernelIndex ny, const KernelIndex nz) {
+    const KernelIndex x = static_cast<KernelIndex>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX +
+                          threadIdx.x + 1;

+                          threadIdx.y + 1;

+// Each block owns a coalesced XY tile and a short Z slab.  XY neighbours are
+// served from shared memory while bottom/centre/top values advance through Z
+// in registers.  Two shared planes are ping-ponged so only one block-wide
+// synchronization is needed per output plane.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY, 4)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output, const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    __shared__ Real tile[2][kBlockY + 2][kBlockX + 2];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t x = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + tx + 1;
+    const size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + ty + 1;
+    const size_t zBegin = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZChunk + 1;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZChunk), nz - 1);
+    const size_t planeStride = nx * ny;
+
+    // Threads outside a partial edge tile still populate shared memory using
+    // clamped coordinates, allowing all threads to reach every barrier.
+    const size_t loadX = min(x, nx - 1);
+    const size_t loadY = min(y, ny - 1);
+    size_t centerIndex = zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + loadX;
+
+    Real center = input[centerIndex];
+    Real bottom = input[centerIndex - planeStride];
+    tile[0][ty + 1][tx + 1] = center;
+
+    if (tx == 0) {
+        tile[0][ty + 1][0] = input[centerIndex - 1];
+    }
+    if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {
+        const size_t rightX = min(x + 1, nx - 1);
+        tile[0][ty + 1][kBlockX + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + rightX];
+    }
+    if (ty == 0) {
+        tile[0][0][tx + 1] = input[centerIndex - nx];
+    }
+    if (ty == kBlockY - 1) {
+        const size_t backY = min(y + 1, ny - 1);
+        tile[0][kBlockY + 1][tx + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + backY * nx + loadX];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    int currentPlane = 0;
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+        const Real top = input[centerIndex + planeStride];
+
+        if (x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1) {
+            const Real left = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx];
+            const Real right = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx + 2];
+            const Real front = tile[currentPlane][ty][tx + 1];
+            const Real back = tile[currentPlane][ty + 2][tx + 1];
+            output[z * planeStride + y * nx + x] =
+                (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) / 7.0;
+        }
+
+        if (z + 1 < zEnd) {
+            const int nextPlane = currentPlane ^ 1;
+            const size_t nextIndex = centerIndex + planeStride;
+            tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][tx + 1] = top;
+
+            if (tx == 0) {
+                tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][0] = input[nextIndex - 1];
             }
+            if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {
+                const size_t rightX = min(x + 1, nx - 1);
+                tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][kBlockX + 1] =
+                    input[(z + 1) * planeStride + loadY * nx + rightX];
+            }
+            if (ty == 0) {
+                tile[nextPlane][0][tx + 1] = input[nextIndex - nx];
+            }
+            if (ty == kBlockY - 1) {
+                const size_t backY = min(y + 1, ny - 1);
+                tile[nextPlane][kBlockY + 1][tx + 1] =
+                    input[(z + 1) * planeStride + backY * nx + loadX];
+            }
+            __syncthreads();
+
+            bottom = center;
+            center = top;
+            centerIndex = nextIndex;
+            currentPlane = nextPlane;
         }
     }
 }

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY, 4)
+void naiveStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,

+                        const KernelIndex ny, const KernelIndex nz) {
+    const KernelIndex x = static_cast<KernelIndex>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX +
+                          threadIdx.x + 1;

+// Each block owns a coalesced XY tile and a short Z slab.  XY neighbours are
+// served from shared memory while bottom/centre/top values advance through Z
+// in registers.  Two shared planes are ping-ponged so only one block-wide
+// synchronization is needed per output plane.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY, 4)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output, const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    __shared__ Real tile[2][kBlockY + 2][kBlockX + 2];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t x = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + tx + 1;
+    const size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + ty + 1;
+    const size_t zBegin = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZChunk + 1;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZChunk), nz - 1);
+    const size_t planeStride = nx * ny;
+
+    // Threads outside a partial edge tile still populate shared memory using
+    // clamped coordinates, allowing all threads to reach every barrier.
+    const size_t loadX = min(x, nx - 1);
+    const size_t loadY = min(y, ny - 1);
+    size_t centerIndex = zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + loadX;
+
+    Real center = input[centerIndex];
+    Real bottom = input[centerIndex - planeStride];
+    tile[0][ty + 1][tx + 1] = center;
+
+    if (tx == 0) {
+        tile[0][ty + 1][0] = input[centerIndex - 1];
+    }
+    if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {
+        const size_t rightX = min(x + 1, nx - 1);
+        tile[0][ty + 1][kBlockX + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + rightX];
+    }
+    if (ty == 0) {
+        tile[0][0][tx + 1] = input[centerIndex - nx];
+    }
+    if (ty == kBlockY - 1) {
+        const size_t backY = min(y + 1, ny - 1);
+        tile[0][kBlockY + 1][tx + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + backY * nx + loadX];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    int currentPlane = 0;
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+        const Real top = input[centerIndex + planeStride];
+
+        if (x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1) {
+            const Real left = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx];
+            const Real right = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx + 2];
+            const Real front = tile[currentPlane][ty][tx + 1];
+            const Real back = tile[currentPlane][ty + 2][tx + 1];
+            output[z * planeStride + y * nx + x] =
+                (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) / 7.0;
+        }
+
+        if (z + 1 < zEnd) {
+            const int nextPlane = currentPlane ^ 1;
+            const size_t nextIndex = centerIndex + planeStride;
+            tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][tx + 1] = top;
+
+            if (tx == 0) {
+                tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][0] = input[nextIndex - 1];
             }
+            if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {
+                const size_t rightX = min(x + 1, nx - 1);
+                tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][kBlockX + 1] =
+                    input[(z + 1) * planeStride + loadY * nx + rightX];
+            }
+            if (ty == 0) {
+                tile[nextPlane][0][tx + 1] = input[nextIndex - nx];
+            }
+            if (ty == kBlockY - 1) {
+                const size_t backY = min(y + 1, ny - 1);
+                tile[nextPlane][kBlockY + 1][tx + 1] =
+                    input[(z + 1) * planeStride + backY * nx + loadX];
+            }
+            __syncthreads();
+
+            bottom = center;
+            center = top;
+            centerIndex = nextIndex;
+            currentPlane = nextPlane;
         }
     }
 }

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY, 4)

+    const KernelIndex x = static_cast<KernelIndex>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX +
+                          threadIdx.x + 1;

+// Each block owns a coalesced XY tile and a short Z slab.  XY neighbours are
+// served from shared memory while bottom/centre/top values advance through Z
+// in registers.  Two shared planes are ping-ponged so only one block-wide
+// synchronization is needed per output plane.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY, 4)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output, const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    __shared__ Real tile[2][kBlockY + 2][kBlockX + 2];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t x = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + tx + 1;
+    const size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + ty + 1;
+    const size_t zBegin = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZChunk + 1;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZChunk), nz - 1);
+    const size_t planeStride = nx * ny;
+
+    // Threads outside a partial edge tile still populate shared memory using
+    // clamped coordinates, allowing all threads to reach every barrier.
+    const size_t loadX = min(x, nx - 1);
+    const size_t loadY = min(y, ny - 1);
+    size_t centerIndex = zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + loadX;
+
+    Real center = input[centerIndex];
+    Real bottom = input[centerIndex - planeStride];
+    tile[0][ty + 1][tx + 1] = center;
+
+    if (tx == 0) {
+        tile[0][ty + 1][0] = input[centerIndex - 1];
+    }
+    if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {
+        const size_t rightX = min(x + 1, nx - 1);
+        tile[0][ty + 1][kBlockX + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + rightX];
+    }
+    if (ty == 0) {
+        tile[0][0][tx + 1] = input[centerIndex - nx];
+    }
+    if (ty == kBlockY - 1) {
+        const size_t backY = min(y + 1, ny - 1);
+        tile[0][kBlockY + 1][tx + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + backY * nx + loadX];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    int currentPlane = 0;
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+        const Real top = input[centerIndex + planeStride];
+
+        if (x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1) {
+            const Real left = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx];
+            const Real right = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx + 2];
+            const Real front = tile[currentPlane][ty][tx + 1];
+            const Real back = tile[currentPlane][ty + 2][tx + 1];
+            output[z * planeStride + y * nx + x] =
+                (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) / 7.0;
+        }
+
+        if (z + 1 < zEnd) {
+            const int nextPlane = currentPlane ^ 1;
+            const size_t nextIndex = centerIndex + planeStride;
+            tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][tx + 1] = top;
+
+            if (tx == 0) {
+                tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][0] = input[nextIndex - 1];
             }
+            if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {
+                const size_t rightX = min(x + 1, nx - 1);

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY, 4)
+void naiveStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                        Real* __restrict__ output, const KernelIndex nx,
+                        const KernelIndex ny, const KernelIndex nz) {
+    const KernelIndex x = static_cast<KernelIndex>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX +
+                          threadIdx.x + 1;
+    const KernelIndex y = static_cast<KernelIndex>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY +
+                          threadIdx.y + 1;

+// Each block owns a coalesced XY tile and a short Z slab.  XY neighbours are
+// served from shared memory while bottom/centre/top values advance through Z
+// in registers.  Two shared planes are ping-ponged so only one block-wide
+// synchronization is needed per output plane.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY, 4)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output, const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    __shared__ Real tile[2][kBlockY + 2][kBlockX + 2];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t x = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + tx + 1;
+    const size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + ty + 1;
+    const size_t zBegin = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZChunk + 1;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZChunk), nz - 1);
+    const size_t planeStride = nx * ny;
+
+    // Threads outside a partial edge tile still populate shared memory using
+    // clamped coordinates, allowing all threads to reach every barrier.
+    const size_t loadX = min(x, nx - 1);
+    const size_t loadY = min(y, ny - 1);
+    size_t centerIndex = zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + loadX;
+
+    Real center = input[centerIndex];
+    Real bottom = input[centerIndex - planeStride];
+    tile[0][ty + 1][tx + 1] = center;
+
+    if (tx == 0) {
+        tile[0][ty + 1][0] = input[centerIndex - 1];
+    }
+    if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {
+        const size_t rightX = min(x + 1, nx - 1);
+        tile[0][ty + 1][kBlockX + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + rightX];
+    }
+    if (ty == 0) {
+        tile[0][0][tx + 1] = input[centerIndex - nx];
+    }
+    if (ty == kBlockY - 1) {
+        const size_t backY = min(y + 1, ny - 1);
+        tile[0][kBlockY + 1][tx + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + backY * nx + loadX];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    int currentPlane = 0;
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+        const Real top = input[centerIndex + planeStride];
+
+        if (x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1) {
+            const Real left = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx];
+            const Real right = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx + 2];
+            const Real front = tile[currentPlane][ty][tx + 1];
+            const Real back = tile[currentPlane][ty + 2][tx + 1];
+            output[z * planeStride + y * nx + x] =
+                (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) / 7.0;
+        }
+
+        if (z + 1 < zEnd) {
+            const int nextPlane = currentPlane ^ 1;
+            const size_t nextIndex = centerIndex + planeStride;
+            tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][tx + 1] = top;
+
+            if (tx == 0) {
+                tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][0] = input[nextIndex - 1];
             }
+            if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {
+                const size_t rightX = min(x + 1, nx - 1);
+                tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][kBlockX + 1] =
+                    input[(z + 1) * planeStride + loadY * nx + rightX];
+            }
+            if (ty == 0) {
+                tile[nextPlane][0][tx + 1] = input[nextIndex - nx];
+            }
+            if (ty == kBlockY - 1) {
+                const size_t backY = min(y + 1, ny - 1);
+                tile[nextPlane][kBlockY + 1][tx + 1] =
+                    input[(z + 1) * planeStride + backY * nx + loadX];
+            }
+            __syncthreads();
+
+            bottom = center;
+            center = top;
+            centerIndex = nextIndex;
+            currentPlane = nextPlane;
         }
     }
 }

+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output, const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    __shared__ Real tile[2][kBlockY + 2][kBlockX + 2];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t x = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + tx + 1;
+    const size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + ty + 1;
+    const size_t zBegin = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZChunk + 1;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZChunk), nz - 1);
+    const size_t planeStride = nx * ny;
+
+    // Threads outside a partial edge tile still populate shared memory using
+    // clamped coordinates, allowing all threads to reach every barrier.
+    const size_t loadX = min(x, nx - 1);
+    const size_t loadY = min(y, ny - 1);
+    size_t centerIndex = zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + loadX;
+
+    Real center = input[centerIndex];
+    Real bottom = input[centerIndex - planeStride];
+    tile[0][ty + 1][tx + 1] = center;
+
+    if (tx == 0) {
+        tile[0][ty + 1][0] = input[centerIndex - 1];
+    }
+    if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {
+        const size_t rightX = min(x + 1, nx - 1);
+        tile[0][ty + 1][kBlockX + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + rightX];
+    }
+    if (ty == 0) {
+        tile[0][0][tx + 1] = input[centerIndex - nx];
+    }
+    if (ty == kBlockY - 1) {
+        const size_t backY = min(y + 1, ny - 1);
+        tile[0][kBlockY + 1][tx + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + backY * nx + loadX];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    int currentPlane = 0;
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+        const Real top = input[centerIndex + planeStride];
+
+        if (x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1) {
+            const Real left = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx];
+            const Real right = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx + 2];
+            const Real front = tile[currentPlane][ty][tx + 1];
+            const Real back = tile[currentPlane][ty + 2][tx + 1];
+            output[z * planeStride + y * nx + x] =
+                (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) / 7.0;
+        }
+
+        if (z + 1 < zEnd) {
+            const int nextPlane = currentPlane ^ 1;
+            const size_t nextIndex = centerIndex + planeStride;
+            tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][tx + 1] = top;
+
+            if (tx == 0) {
+                tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][0] = input[nextIndex - 1];
             }
+            if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {
+                const size_t rightX = min(x + 1, nx - 1);
+                tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][kBlockX + 1] =
+                    input[(z + 1) * planeStride + loadY * nx + rightX];
+            }
+            if (ty == 0) {
+                tile[nextPlane][0][tx + 1] = input[nextIndex - nx];
+            }
+            if (ty == kBlockY - 1) {
+                const size_t backY = min(y + 1, ny - 1);
+                tile[nextPlane][kBlockY + 1][tx + 1] =
+                    input[(z + 1) * planeStride + backY * nx + loadX];
+            }
+            __syncthreads();
+
+            bottom = center;
+            center = top;
+            centerIndex = nextIndex;
+            currentPlane = nextPlane;
         }
     }
 }
