+void naiveStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                        Real* __restrict__ output, const KernelIndex nx,
+                        const KernelIndex ny, const KernelIndex nz) {
+    const KernelIndex x = static_cast<KernelIndex>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX +
+                          threadIdx.x + 1;
+    const KernelIndex y = static_cast<KernelIndex>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY +
+                          threadIdx.y + 1;
+    const KernelIndex z = static_cast<KernelIndex>(blockIdx.z) + 1;
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || z >= nz - 1) return;
+    const KernelIndex planeStride = nx * ny;
+    const KernelIndex index = z * planeStride + y * nx + x;
+    const Real center = input[index];
+    const Real left = input[index - 1];
+    const Real right = input[index + 1];
+    const Real front = input[index - nx];
+    const Real back = input[index + nx];
+    const Real bottom = input[index - planeStride];
+    const Real top = input[index + planeStride];
+    output[index] =
+        (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) / 7.0;
+}
+#endif
+
+// Each block owns a coalesced XY tile and a short Z slab.  XY neighbours are
+// served from shared memory while bottom/centre/top values advance through Z
+// in registers.  Two shared planes are ping-ponged so only one block-wide
+// synchronization is needed per output plane.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY, 4)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output, const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    __shared__ Real tile[2][kBlockY + 2][kBlockX + 2];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t x = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + tx + 1;
+    const size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + ty + 1;
+    const size_t zBegin = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZChunk + 1;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZChunk), nz - 1);
+    const size_t planeStride = nx * ny;
+
+    // Threads outside a partial edge tile still populate shared memory using
+    // clamped coordinates, allowing all threads to reach every barrier.
+    const size_t loadX = min(x, nx - 1);
+    const size_t loadY = min(y, ny - 1);
+    size_t centerIndex = zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + loadX;
+
+    Real center = input[centerIndex];
+    Real bottom = input[centerIndex - planeStride];
+    tile[0][ty + 1][tx + 1] = center;
+
+    if (tx == 0) {
+        tile[0][ty + 1][0] = input[centerIndex - 1];
+    }
+    if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {
+        const size_t rightX = min(x + 1, nx - 1);
+        tile[0][ty + 1][kBlockX + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + rightX];
+    }
+    if (ty == 0) {
+        tile[0][0][tx + 1] = input[centerIndex - nx];
+    }
+    if (ty == kBlockY - 1) {
+        const size_t backY = min(y + 1, ny - 1);
+        tile[0][kBlockY + 1][tx + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + backY * nx + loadX];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    int currentPlane = 0;
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+        const Real top = input[centerIndex + planeStride];
+
+        if (x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1) {
+            const Real left = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx];
+            const Real right = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx + 2];
+            const Real front = tile[currentPlane][ty][tx + 1];
+            const Real back = tile[currentPlane][ty + 2][tx + 1];
+            output[z * planeStride + y * nx + x] =
+                (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) / 7.0;
+        }
+
+        if (z + 1 < zEnd) {
+            const int nextPlane = currentPlane ^ 1;
+            const size_t nextIndex = centerIndex + planeStride;
+            tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][tx + 1] = top;
+
+            if (tx == 0) {
+                tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][0] = input[nextIndex - 1];
             }
+            if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {
+                const size_t rightX = min(x + 1, nx - 1);
+                tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][kBlockX + 1] =
+                    input[(z + 1) * planeStride + loadY * nx + rightX];
+            }
+            if (ty == 0) {
+                tile[nextPlane][0][tx + 1] = input[nextIndex - nx];
+            }
+            if (ty == kBlockY - 1) {
+                const size_t backY = min(y + 1, ny - 1);
+                tile[nextPlane][kBlockY + 1][tx + 1] =
+                    input[(z + 1) * planeStride + backY * nx + loadX];
+            }
+            __syncthreads();
+
+            bottom = center;
+            center = top;
+            centerIndex = nextIndex;
+            currentPlane = nextPlane;
         }
     }
 }

+                         threadIdx.x;

+    for (size_t index = first; index < elementCount; index += stride) {
+        const Real value = static_cast<Real>(index % 19);
+        grid1[index] = value;
+        grid2[index] = value;
     }

-                }

+#ifdef STENCIL_INDEX32
+using KernelIndex = unsigned int;
+#else
+using KernelIndex = size_t;
+#endif
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY, 4)
+void naiveStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                        Real* __restrict__ output, const KernelIndex nx,
+                        const KernelIndex ny, const KernelIndex nz) {
+    const KernelIndex x = static_cast<KernelIndex>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX +
+                          threadIdx.x + 1;
+    const KernelIndex y = static_cast<KernelIndex>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY +
+                          threadIdx.y + 1;
+    const KernelIndex z = static_cast<KernelIndex>(blockIdx.z) + 1;
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || z >= nz - 1) return;
+    const KernelIndex planeStride = nx * ny;
+    const KernelIndex index = z * planeStride + y * nx + x;
+    const Real center = input[index];
+    const Real left = input[index - 1];
+    const Real right = input[index + 1];
+    const Real front = input[index - nx];
+    const Real back = input[index + nx];
+    const Real bottom = input[index - planeStride];
+    const Real top = input[index + planeStride];
+    output[index] =
+        (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) / 7.0;
+}
+#endif
+
+// Each block owns a coalesced XY tile and a short Z slab.  XY neighbours are
+// served from shared memory while bottom/centre/top values advance through Z
+// in registers.  Two shared planes are ping-ponged so only one block-wide
+// synchronization is needed per output plane.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY, 4)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output, const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    __shared__ Real tile[2][kBlockY + 2][kBlockX + 2];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t x = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + tx + 1;
+    const size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + ty + 1;
+    const size_t zBegin = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZChunk + 1;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZChunk), nz - 1);
+    const size_t planeStride = nx * ny;
+
+    // Threads outside a partial edge tile still populate shared memory using
+    // clamped coordinates, allowing all threads to reach every barrier.
+    const size_t loadX = min(x, nx - 1);
+    const size_t loadY = min(y, ny - 1);
+    size_t centerIndex = zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + loadX;
+
+    Real center = input[centerIndex];
+    Real bottom = input[centerIndex - planeStride];
+    tile[0][ty + 1][tx + 1] = center;
+
+    if (tx == 0) {
+        tile[0][ty + 1][0] = input[centerIndex - 1];
+    }
+    if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {
+        const size_t rightX = min(x + 1, nx - 1);
+        tile[0][ty + 1][kBlockX + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + rightX];
+    }
+    if (ty == 0) {
+        tile[0][0][tx + 1] = input[centerIndex - nx];
+    }
+    if (ty == kBlockY - 1) {
+        const size_t backY = min(y + 1, ny - 1);
+        tile[0][kBlockY + 1][tx + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + backY * nx + loadX];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    int currentPlane = 0;
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+        const Real top = input[centerIndex + planeStride];
+
+        if (x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1) {
+            const Real left = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx];
+            const Real right = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx + 2];
+            const Real front = tile[currentPlane][ty][tx + 1];
+            const Real back = tile[currentPlane][ty + 2][tx + 1];
+            output[z * planeStride + y * nx + x] =
+                (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) / 7.0;
+        }
+
+        if (z + 1 < zEnd) {
+            const int nextPlane = currentPlane ^ 1;
+            const size_t nextIndex = centerIndex + planeStride;
+            tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][tx + 1] = top;
+
+            if (tx == 0) {
+                tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][0] = input[nextIndex - 1];
             }
+            if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {
+                const size_t rightX = min(x + 1, nx - 1);
+                tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][kBlockX + 1] =
+                    input[(z + 1) * planeStride + loadY * nx + rightX];
+            }
+            if (ty == 0) {
+                tile[nextPlane][0][tx + 1] = input[nextIndex - nx];
+            }
+            if (ty == kBlockY - 1) {
+                const size_t backY = min(y + 1, ny - 1);
+                tile[nextPlane][kBlockY + 1][tx + 1] =
+                    input[(z + 1) * planeStride + backY * nx + loadX];
+            }
+            __syncthreads();
+
+            bottom = center;
+            center = top;
+            centerIndex = nextIndex;
+            currentPlane = nextPlane;
         }
     }
 }

+using KernelIndex = unsigned int;
+#else
+using KernelIndex = size_t;
+#endif
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY, 4)
+void naiveStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                        Real* __restrict__ output, const KernelIndex nx,
+                        const KernelIndex ny, const KernelIndex nz) {
+    const KernelIndex x = static_cast<KernelIndex>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX +
+                          threadIdx.x + 1;
+    const KernelIndex y = static_cast<KernelIndex>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY +
+                          threadIdx.y + 1;
+    const KernelIndex z = static_cast<KernelIndex>(blockIdx.z) + 1;
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || z >= nz - 1) return;
+    const KernelIndex planeStride = nx * ny;
+    const KernelIndex index = z * planeStride + y * nx + x;
+    const Real center = input[index];
+    const Real left = input[index - 1];
+    const Real right = input[index + 1];
+    const Real front = input[index - nx];
+    const Real back = input[index + nx];
+    const Real bottom = input[index - planeStride];
+    const Real top = input[index + planeStride];
+    output[index] =
+        (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) / 7.0;
+}
+#endif
+
+// Each block owns a coalesced XY tile and a short Z slab.  XY neighbours are
+// served from shared memory while bottom/centre/top values advance through Z
+// in registers.  Two shared planes are ping-ponged so only one block-wide
+// synchronization is needed per output plane.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY, 4)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output, const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    __shared__ Real tile[2][kBlockY + 2][kBlockX + 2];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t x = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + tx + 1;
+    const size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + ty + 1;
+    const size_t zBegin = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZChunk + 1;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZChunk), nz - 1);
+    const size_t planeStride = nx * ny;
+
+    // Threads outside a partial edge tile still populate shared memory using
+    // clamped coordinates, allowing all threads to reach every barrier.
+    const size_t loadX = min(x, nx - 1);
+    const size_t loadY = min(y, ny - 1);
+    size_t centerIndex = zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + loadX;
+
+    Real center = input[centerIndex];
+    Real bottom = input[centerIndex - planeStride];
+    tile[0][ty + 1][tx + 1] = center;
+
+    if (tx == 0) {
+        tile[0][ty + 1][0] = input[centerIndex - 1];
+    }
+    if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {
+        const size_t rightX = min(x + 1, nx - 1);
+        tile[0][ty + 1][kBlockX + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + rightX];
+    }
+    if (ty == 0) {
+        tile[0][0][tx + 1] = input[centerIndex - nx];
+    }
+    if (ty == kBlockY - 1) {
+        const size_t backY = min(y + 1, ny - 1);
+        tile[0][kBlockY + 1][tx + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + backY * nx + loadX];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    int currentPlane = 0;
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+        const Real top = input[centerIndex + planeStride];
+
+        if (x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1) {
+            const Real left = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx];
+            const Real right = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx + 2];
+            const Real front = tile[currentPlane][ty][tx + 1];
+            const Real back = tile[currentPlane][ty + 2][tx + 1];
+            output[z * planeStride + y * nx + x] =
+                (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) / 7.0;
+        }
+
+        if (z + 1 < zEnd) {
+            const int nextPlane = currentPlane ^ 1;
+            const size_t nextIndex = centerIndex + planeStride;
+            tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][tx + 1] = top;
+
+            if (tx == 0) {
+                tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][0] = input[nextIndex - 1];
             }
+            if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {
+                const size_t rightX = min(x + 1, nx - 1);
+                tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][kBlockX + 1] =
+                    input[(z + 1) * planeStride + loadY * nx + rightX];
+            }
+            if (ty == 0) {
+                tile[nextPlane][0][tx + 1] = input[nextIndex - nx];
+            }
+            if (ty == kBlockY - 1) {
+                const size_t backY = min(y + 1, ny - 1);
+                tile[nextPlane][kBlockY + 1][tx + 1] =
+                    input[(z + 1) * planeStride + backY * nx + loadX];
+            }
+            __syncthreads();
+
+            bottom = center;
+            center = top;
+            centerIndex = nextIndex;
+            currentPlane = nextPlane;
         }
     }
 }

+using StreamIndex = unsigned int;
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY, 4)
+void streamStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                         Real* __restrict__ output, const StreamIndex nx,
+                         const StreamIndex ny, const StreamIndex nz) {
+    const StreamIndex x = static_cast<StreamIndex>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX +
+                          threadIdx.x + 1;
+    const StreamIndex y = static_cast<StreamIndex>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY +
+                          threadIdx.y + 1;

+#ifdef STENCIL_NAIVE

+using KernelIndex = unsigned int;
+#else
+using KernelIndex = size_t;

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY, 4)
+void naiveStencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                        Real* __restrict__ output, const KernelIndex nx,
+                        const KernelIndex ny, const KernelIndex nz) {
+    const KernelIndex x = static_cast<KernelIndex>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX +
+                          threadIdx.x + 1;
+    const KernelIndex y = static_cast<KernelIndex>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY +
+                          threadIdx.y + 1;
+    const KernelIndex z = static_cast<KernelIndex>(blockIdx.z) + 1;
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || z >= nz - 1) return;
+    const KernelIndex planeStride = nx * ny;
+    const KernelIndex index = z * planeStride + y * nx + x;
+    const Real center = input[index];
+    const Real left = input[index - 1];
+    const Real right = input[index + 1];
+    const Real front = input[index - nx];
+    const Real back = input[index + nx];
+    const Real bottom = input[index - planeStride];
+    const Real top = input[index + planeStride];
+    output[index] =
+        (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) / 7.0;
+}
+#endif
+
+// Each block owns a coalesced XY tile and a short Z slab.  XY neighbours are
+// served from shared memory while bottom/centre/top values advance through Z
+// in registers.  Two shared planes are ping-ponged so only one block-wide
+// synchronization is needed per output plane.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY, 4)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output, const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    __shared__ Real tile[2][kBlockY + 2][kBlockX + 2];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t x = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + tx + 1;
+    const size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + ty + 1;
+    const size_t zBegin = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZChunk + 1;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZChunk), nz - 1);
+    const size_t planeStride = nx * ny;
+
+    // Threads outside a partial edge tile still populate shared memory using
+    // clamped coordinates, allowing all threads to reach every barrier.
+    const size_t loadX = min(x, nx - 1);
+    const size_t loadY = min(y, ny - 1);
+    size_t centerIndex = zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + loadX;
+
+    Real center = input[centerIndex];
+    Real bottom = input[centerIndex - planeStride];
+    tile[0][ty + 1][tx + 1] = center;
+
+    if (tx == 0) {
+        tile[0][ty + 1][0] = input[centerIndex - 1];
+    }
+    if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {
+        const size_t rightX = min(x + 1, nx - 1);
+        tile[0][ty + 1][kBlockX + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + loadY * nx + rightX];
+    }
+    if (ty == 0) {
+        tile[0][0][tx + 1] = input[centerIndex - nx];
+    }
+    if (ty == kBlockY - 1) {
+        const size_t backY = min(y + 1, ny - 1);
+        tile[0][kBlockY + 1][tx + 1] =
+            input[zBegin * planeStride + backY * nx + loadX];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    int currentPlane = 0;
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+        const Real top = input[centerIndex + planeStride];
+
+        if (x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1) {
+            const Real left = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx];
+            const Real right = tile[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx + 2];
+            const Real front = tile[currentPlane][ty][tx + 1];
+            const Real back = tile[currentPlane][ty + 2][tx + 1];
+            output[z * planeStride + y * nx + x] =
+                (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) / 7.0;
+        }
+
+        if (z + 1 < zEnd) {
+            const int nextPlane = currentPlane ^ 1;
+            const size_t nextIndex = centerIndex + planeStride;
+            tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][tx + 1] = top;
+
+            if (tx == 0) {
+                tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][0] = input[nextIndex - 1];
             }
+            if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {
+                const size_t rightX = min(x + 1, nx - 1);
+                tile[nextPlane][ty + 1][kBlockX + 1] =
+                    input[(z + 1) * planeStride + loadY * nx + rightX];
+            }
+            if (ty == 0) {
+                tile[nextPlane][0][tx + 1] = input[nextIndex - nx];
+            }
+            if (ty == kBlockY - 1) {
+                const size_t backY = min(y + 1, ny - 1);
+                tile[nextPlane][kBlockY + 1][tx + 1] =
+                    input[(z + 1) * planeStride + backY * nx + loadX];
+            }
+            __syncthreads();
+
+            bottom = center;
+            center = top;
+            centerIndex = nextIndex;
+            currentPlane = nextPlane;
         }
     }
 }

codex
Profiling showed an important hardware-specific result: on this Ampere GPU, an explicitly shared-memory tile was slower because the stencil’s overlapping reads are already captured effectively by the unified L1/L2 caches, while barriers reduced throughput. A coalesced cache-backed kernel with short register-resident Z runs reaches about 20 billion cell updates/s on larger grids. I’m keeping that faster path and adding size-aware launch geometry plus CUDA Graph execution to reduce per-iteration launch overhead.

+
+// X is mapped to complete warps for fully coalesced access.  On large grids a
+// thread advances through a short Z run, retaining bottom and centre in
+// registers.  The cache hierarchy supplies the overlapping X/Y reads more
+// cheaply than an explicitly synchronized shared-memory tile on modern GPUs.
+template <typename Index, int BlockY, int ZChunk>
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * BlockY, 8)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output, const Index nx, const Index ny,
+                   const Index nz) {
+    const Index xGridStride = static_cast<Index>(gridDim.x) * kBlockX;
+    const Index yGridStride = static_cast<Index>(gridDim.y) * BlockY;
+    const Index zGridStride = static_cast<Index>(gridDim.z) * ZChunk;
+
+    for (Index xBase = static_cast<Index>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + 1;
+         xBase < nx - 1; xBase += xGridStride) {
+        const Index x = xBase + static_cast<Index>(threadIdx.x);
+        if (x >= nx - 1) continue;
+
+        for (Index yBase = static_cast<Index>(blockIdx.y) * BlockY + 1;
+             yBase < ny - 1; yBase += yGridStride) {
+            const Index y = yBase + static_cast<Index>(threadIdx.y);
+            if (y >= ny - 1) continue;
+
+            const Index planeStride = nx * ny;
+            for (Index zBegin =
+                     static_cast<Index>(blockIdx.z) * ZChunk + 1;
+                 zBegin < nz - 1; zBegin += zGridStride) {
+                const Index zEnd =
+                    min(zBegin + static_cast<Index>(ZChunk), nz - 1);
+                Index index = zBegin * planeStride + y * nx + x;
+                Real bottom = input[index - planeStride];
+                Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll
+                for (Index z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+                    const Real left = input[index - 1];
+                    const Real right = input[index + 1];
+                    const Real front = input[index - nx];
+                    const Real back = input[index + nx];
+                    const Real top = input[index + planeStride];
+                    output[index] =
+                        (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) /
+                        7.0;
+                    bottom = center;
+                    center = top;
+                    index += planeStride;
                 }
             }
         }
     }
 }

+
+// X is mapped to complete warps for fully coalesced access.  On large grids a
+// thread advances through a short Z run, retaining bottom and centre in
+// registers.  The cache hierarchy supplies the overlapping X/Y reads more
+// cheaply than an explicitly synchronized shared-memory tile on modern GPUs.
+template <typename Index, int BlockY, int ZChunk>
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * BlockY, 8)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output, const Index nx, const Index ny,
+                   const Index nz) {
+    const Index xGridStride = static_cast<Index>(gridDim.x) * kBlockX;
+    const Index yGridStride = static_cast<Index>(gridDim.y) * BlockY;
+    const Index zGridStride = static_cast<Index>(gridDim.z) * ZChunk;
+
+    for (Index xBase = static_cast<Index>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + 1;
+         xBase < nx - 1; xBase += xGridStride) {
+        const Index x = xBase + static_cast<Index>(threadIdx.x);
+        if (x >= nx - 1) continue;
+
+        for (Index yBase = static_cast<Index>(blockIdx.y) * BlockY + 1;
+             yBase < ny - 1; yBase += yGridStride) {
+            const Index y = yBase + static_cast<Index>(threadIdx.y);
+            if (y >= ny - 1) continue;
+
+            const Index planeStride = nx * ny;
+            for (Index zBegin =
+                     static_cast<Index>(blockIdx.z) * ZChunk + 1;
+                 zBegin < nz - 1; zBegin += zGridStride) {
+                const Index zEnd =
+                    min(zBegin + static_cast<Index>(ZChunk), nz - 1);
+                Index index = zBegin * planeStride + y * nx + x;
+                Real bottom = input[index - planeStride];
+                Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll
+                for (Index z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+                    const Real left = input[index - 1];
+                    const Real right = input[index + 1];
+                    const Real front = input[index - nx];
+                    const Real back = input[index + nx];
+                    const Real top = input[index + planeStride];
+                    output[index] =
+                        (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) /
+                        7.0;
+                    bottom = center;
+                    center = top;
+                    index += planeStride;
                 }
             }
         }
     }
 }

+
+// X is mapped to complete warps for fully coalesced access.  On large grids a
+// thread advances through a short Z run, retaining bottom and centre in
+// registers.  The cache hierarchy supplies the overlapping X/Y reads more
+// cheaply than an explicitly synchronized shared-memory tile on modern GPUs.
+template <typename Index, int BlockY, int ZChunk>
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * BlockY, 8)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output, const Index nx, const Index ny,
+                   const Index nz) {
+    const Index xGridStride = static_cast<Index>(gridDim.x) * kBlockX;
+    const Index yGridStride = static_cast<Index>(gridDim.y) * BlockY;
+    const Index zGridStride = static_cast<Index>(gridDim.z) * ZChunk;
+
+    for (Index xBase = static_cast<Index>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + 1;
+         xBase < nx - 1; xBase += xGridStride) {
+        const Index x = xBase + static_cast<Index>(threadIdx.x);
+        if (x >= nx - 1) continue;
+
+        for (Index yBase = static_cast<Index>(blockIdx.y) * BlockY + 1;
+             yBase < ny - 1; yBase += yGridStride) {
+            const Index y = yBase + static_cast<Index>(threadIdx.y);
+            if (y >= ny - 1) continue;
+
+            const Index planeStride = nx * ny;
+            for (Index zBegin =
+                     static_cast<Index>(blockIdx.z) * ZChunk + 1;
+                 zBegin < nz - 1; zBegin += zGridStride) {
+                const Index zEnd =
+                    min(zBegin + static_cast<Index>(ZChunk), nz - 1);
+                Index index = zBegin * planeStride + y * nx + x;
+                Real bottom = input[index - planeStride];
+                Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll
+                for (Index z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+                    const Real left = input[index - 1];
+                    const Real right = input[index + 1];
+                    const Real front = input[index - nx];
+                    const Real back = input[index + nx];
+                    const Real top = input[index + planeStride];
+                    output[index] =
+                        (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) /
+                        7.0;
+                    bottom = center;
+                    center = top;
+                    index += planeStride;
                 }
             }
         }
     }
 }

+
+// X is mapped to complete warps for fully coalesced access.  On large grids a
+// thread advances through a short Z run, retaining bottom and centre in
+// registers.  The cache hierarchy supplies the overlapping X/Y reads more
+// cheaply than an explicitly synchronized shared-memory tile on modern GPUs.
+template <typename Index, int BlockY, int ZChunk>
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * BlockY, 8)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output, const Index nx, const Index ny,
+                   const Index nz) {
+    const Index xGridStride = static_cast<Index>(gridDim.x) * kBlockX;
+    const Index yGridStride = static_cast<Index>(gridDim.y) * BlockY;
+    const Index zGridStride = static_cast<Index>(gridDim.z) * ZChunk;
+
+    for (Index xBase = static_cast<Index>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + 1;
+         xBase < nx - 1; xBase += xGridStride) {
+        const Index x = xBase + static_cast<Index>(threadIdx.x);
+        if (x >= nx - 1) continue;
+
+        for (Index yBase = static_cast<Index>(blockIdx.y) * BlockY + 1;
+             yBase < ny - 1; yBase += yGridStride) {
+            const Index y = yBase + static_cast<Index>(threadIdx.y);
+            if (y >= ny - 1) continue;
+
+            const Index planeStride = nx * ny;
+            for (Index zBegin =
+                     static_cast<Index>(blockIdx.z) * ZChunk + 1;
+                 zBegin < nz - 1; zBegin += zGridStride) {
+                const Index zEnd =
+                    min(zBegin + static_cast<Index>(ZChunk), nz - 1);
+                Index index = zBegin * planeStride + y * nx + x;
+                Real bottom = input[index - planeStride];
+                Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll
+                for (Index z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+                    const Real left = input[index - 1];
+                    const Real right = input[index + 1];
+                    const Real front = input[index - nx];
+                    const Real back = input[index + nx];
+                    const Real top = input[index + planeStride];
+                    output[index] =
+                        (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) /
+                        7.0;
+                    bottom = center;
+                    center = top;
+                    index += planeStride;
                 }
             }
         }
     }
 }

+GraphRun captureStencilGraph(Real* grid1, Real* grid2, const size_t nx,

+
+// X is mapped to complete warps for fully coalesced access.  On large grids a
+// thread advances through a short Z run, retaining bottom and centre in
+// registers.  The cache hierarchy supplies the overlapping X/Y reads more
+// cheaply than an explicitly synchronized shared-memory tile on modern GPUs.
+template <typename Index, int BlockY, int ZChunk>
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * BlockY, 8)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output, const Index nx, const Index ny,
+                   const Index nz) {
+    const Index xGridStride = static_cast<Index>(gridDim.x) * kBlockX;
+    const Index yGridStride = static_cast<Index>(gridDim.y) * BlockY;
+    const Index zGridStride = static_cast<Index>(gridDim.z) * ZChunk;
+
+    for (Index xBase = static_cast<Index>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + 1;
+         xBase < nx - 1; xBase += xGridStride) {
+        const Index x = xBase + static_cast<Index>(threadIdx.x);
+        if (x >= nx - 1) continue;
+
+        for (Index yBase = static_cast<Index>(blockIdx.y) * BlockY + 1;
+             yBase < ny - 1; yBase += yGridStride) {
+            const Index y = yBase + static_cast<Index>(threadIdx.y);
+            if (y >= ny - 1) continue;
+
+            const Index planeStride = nx * ny;
+            for (Index zBegin =
+                     static_cast<Index>(blockIdx.z) * ZChunk + 1;
+                 zBegin < nz - 1; zBegin += zGridStride) {
+                const Index zEnd =
+                    min(zBegin + static_cast<Index>(ZChunk), nz - 1);
+                Index index = zBegin * planeStride + y * nx + x;
+                Real bottom = input[index - planeStride];
+                Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll
+                for (Index z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+                    const Real left = input[index - 1];
+                    const Real right = input[index + 1];
+                    const Real front = input[index - nx];
+                    const Real back = input[index + nx];
+                    const Real top = input[index + planeStride];
+                    output[index] =
+                        (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) /
+                        7.0;
+                    bottom = center;
+                    center = top;
+                    index += planeStride;
                 }
             }
         }
     }
 }

+
+// X is mapped to complete warps for fully coalesced access.  On large grids a
+// thread advances through a short Z run, retaining bottom and centre in
+// registers.  The cache hierarchy supplies the overlapping X/Y reads more
+// cheaply than an explicitly synchronized shared-memory tile on modern GPUs.
+template <typename Index, int BlockY, int ZChunk>
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * BlockY, 8)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output, const Index nx, const Index ny,
+                   const Index nz) {
+    const Index xGridStride = static_cast<Index>(gridDim.x) * kBlockX;
+    const Index yGridStride = static_cast<Index>(gridDim.y) * BlockY;
+    const Index zGridStride = static_cast<Index>(gridDim.z) * ZChunk;
+
+    for (Index xBase = static_cast<Index>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + 1;
+         xBase < nx - 1; xBase += xGridStride) {
+        const Index x = xBase + static_cast<Index>(threadIdx.x);
+        if (x >= nx - 1) continue;
+
+        for (Index yBase = static_cast<Index>(blockIdx.y) * BlockY + 1;
+             yBase < ny - 1; yBase += yGridStride) {
+            const Index y = yBase + static_cast<Index>(threadIdx.y);
+            if (y >= ny - 1) continue;
+
+            const Index planeStride = nx * ny;
+            for (Index zBegin =
+                     static_cast<Index>(blockIdx.z) * ZChunk + 1;
+                 zBegin < nz - 1; zBegin += zGridStride) {
+                const Index zEnd =
+                    min(zBegin + static_cast<Index>(ZChunk), nz - 1);
+                Index index = zBegin * planeStride + y * nx + x;
+                Real bottom = input[index - planeStride];
+                Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll
+                for (Index z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+                    const Real left = input[index - 1];
+                    const Real right = input[index + 1];
+                    const Real front = input[index - nx];
+                    const Real back = input[index + nx];
+                    const Real top = input[index + planeStride];
+                    output[index] =
+                        (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) /
+                        7.0;
+                    bottom = center;
+                    center = top;
+                    index += planeStride;
                 }
             }
         }
     }
 }

+
+// X is mapped to complete warps for fully coalesced access.  On large grids a
+// thread advances through a short Z run, retaining bottom and centre in
+// registers.  The cache hierarchy supplies the overlapping X/Y reads more
+// cheaply than an explicitly synchronized shared-memory tile on modern GPUs.
+template <typename Index, int BlockY, int ZChunk>
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * BlockY, 8)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output, const Index nx, const Index ny,
+                   const Index nz) {
+    const Index xGridStride = static_cast<Index>(gridDim.x) * kBlockX;
+    const Index yGridStride = static_cast<Index>(gridDim.y) * BlockY;
+    const Index zGridStride = static_cast<Index>(gridDim.z) * ZChunk;
+
+    for (Index xBase = static_cast<Index>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + 1;
+         xBase < nx - 1; xBase += xGridStride) {
+        const Index x = xBase + static_cast<Index>(threadIdx.x);
+        if (x >= nx - 1) continue;
+
+        for (Index yBase = static_cast<Index>(blockIdx.y) * BlockY + 1;
+             yBase < ny - 1; yBase += yGridStride) {
+            const Index y = yBase + static_cast<Index>(threadIdx.y);
+            if (y >= ny - 1) continue;
+
+            const Index planeStride = nx * ny;
+            for (Index zBegin =
+                     static_cast<Index>(blockIdx.z) * ZChunk + 1;
+                 zBegin < nz - 1; zBegin += zGridStride) {
+                const Index zEnd =
+                    min(zBegin + static_cast<Index>(ZChunk), nz - 1);
+                Index index = zBegin * planeStride + y * nx + x;
+                Real bottom = input[index - planeStride];
+                Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll
+                for (Index z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+                    const Real left = input[index - 1];
+                    const Real right = input[index + 1];
+                    const Real front = input[index - nx];
+                    const Real back = input[index + nx];
+                    const Real top = input[index + planeStride];
+                    output[index] =
+                        (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) /
+                        7.0;
+                    bottom = center;
+                    center = top;
+                    index += planeStride;
                 }
             }
         }
     }
 }

codex
The final kernel now selects a low-latency one-plane mapping for smaller domains and an eight-plane register-reuse mapping once the grid is large enough to benefit. Both paths use 32-wide coalesced warps, 32-bit indexing when safe, grid-stride coverage beyond CUDA dimension limits, invariant device boundaries, and a captured CUDA Graph for the full Jacobi iteration chain. Exact-hash checks continue to pass.

+
+// X is mapped to complete warps for fully coalesced access.  On large grids a
+// thread advances through a short Z run, retaining bottom and centre in
+// registers.  The cache hierarchy supplies the overlapping X/Y reads more
+// cheaply than an explicitly synchronized shared-memory tile on modern GPUs.
+template <typename Index, int BlockY, int ZChunk>
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * BlockY, 8)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output, const Index nx, const Index ny,
+                   const Index nz) {
+    const Index xGridStride = static_cast<Index>(gridDim.x) * kBlockX;
+    const Index yGridStride = static_cast<Index>(gridDim.y) * BlockY;
+    const Index zGridStride = static_cast<Index>(gridDim.z) * ZChunk;
+
+    for (Index xBase = static_cast<Index>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + 1;
+         xBase < nx - 1; xBase += xGridStride) {
+        const Index x = xBase + static_cast<Index>(threadIdx.x);
+        if (x >= nx - 1) continue;
+
+        for (Index yBase = static_cast<Index>(blockIdx.y) * BlockY + 1;
+             yBase < ny - 1; yBase += yGridStride) {
+            const Index y = yBase + static_cast<Index>(threadIdx.y);
+            if (y >= ny - 1) continue;
+
+            const Index planeStride = nx * ny;
+            for (Index zBegin =
+                     static_cast<Index>(blockIdx.z) * ZChunk + 1;
+                 zBegin < nz - 1; zBegin += zGridStride) {
+                const Index zEnd =
+                    min(zBegin + static_cast<Index>(ZChunk), nz - 1);
+                Index index = zBegin * planeStride + y * nx + x;
+                Real bottom = input[index - planeStride];
+                Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll
+                for (Index z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+                    const Real left = input[index - 1];
+                    const Real right = input[index + 1];
+                    const Real front = input[index - nx];
+                    const Real back = input[index + nx];
+                    const Real top = input[index + planeStride];
+                    output[index] =
+                        (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) /
+                        7.0;
+                    bottom = center;
+                    center = top;
+                    index += planeStride;
                 }
             }
         }
     }
 }

+
+// X is mapped to complete warps for fully coalesced access.  On large grids a
+// thread advances through a short Z run, retaining bottom and centre in
+// registers.  The cache hierarchy supplies the overlapping X/Y reads more
+// cheaply than an explicitly synchronized shared-memory tile on modern GPUs.
+template <typename Index, int BlockY, int ZChunk>
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * BlockY, 8)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output, const Index nx, const Index ny,
+                   const Index nz) {
+    const Index xGridStride = static_cast<Index>(gridDim.x) * kBlockX;
+    const Index yGridStride = static_cast<Index>(gridDim.y) * BlockY;
+    const Index zGridStride = static_cast<Index>(gridDim.z) * ZChunk;
+
+    for (Index xBase = static_cast<Index>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + 1;
+         xBase < nx - 1; xBase += xGridStride) {
+        const Index x = xBase + static_cast<Index>(threadIdx.x);
+        if (x >= nx - 1) continue;
+
+        for (Index yBase = static_cast<Index>(blockIdx.y) * BlockY + 1;
+             yBase < ny - 1; yBase += yGridStride) {
+            const Index y = yBase + static_cast<Index>(threadIdx.y);
+            if (y >= ny - 1) continue;
+
+            const Index planeStride = nx * ny;
+            for (Index zBegin =
+                     static_cast<Index>(blockIdx.z) * ZChunk + 1;
+                 zBegin < nz - 1; zBegin += zGridStride) {
+                const Index zEnd =
+                    min(zBegin + static_cast<Index>(ZChunk), nz - 1);
+                Index index = zBegin * planeStride + y * nx + x;
+                Real bottom = input[index - planeStride];
+                Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll
+                for (Index z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+                    const Real left = input[index - 1];
+                    const Real right = input[index + 1];
+                    const Real front = input[index - nx];
+                    const Real back = input[index + nx];
+                    const Real top = input[index + planeStride];
+                    output[index] =
+                        (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) /
+                        7.0;
+                    bottom = center;
+                    center = top;
+                    index += planeStride;
                 }
             }
         }
     }
 }

+GraphRun captureStencilGraph(Real* grid1, Real* grid2, const size_t nx,

    59	                   Real* __restrict__ output, const Index nx, const Index ny,
    60	                   const Index nz) {
    61	    const Index xGridStride = static_cast<Index>(gridDim.x) * kBlockX;
    62	    const Index yGridStride = static_cast<Index>(gridDim.y) * BlockY;
    63	    const Index zGridStride = static_cast<Index>(gridDim.z) * ZChunk;
    64	
    65	    for (Index xBase = static_cast<Index>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + 1;
    66	         xBase < nx - 1; xBase += xGridStride) {
    67	        const Index x = xBase + static_cast<Index>(threadIdx.x);
    68	        if (x >= nx - 1) continue;
    69	
    70	        for (Index yBase = static_cast<Index>(blockIdx.y) * BlockY + 1;
    71	             yBase < ny - 1; yBase += yGridStride) {
    72	            const Index y = yBase + static_cast<Index>(threadIdx.y);
    73	            if (y >= ny - 1) continue;
    74	
    75	            const Index planeStride = nx * ny;
    76	            for (Index zBegin =
    77	                     static_cast<Index>(blockIdx.z) * ZChunk + 1;
    78	                 zBegin < nz - 1; zBegin += zGridStride) {
    79	                const Index zEnd =
    80	                    min(zBegin + static_cast<Index>(ZChunk), nz - 1);
    81	                Index index = zBegin * planeStride + y * nx + x;
    82	                Real bottom = input[index - planeStride];
    83	                Real center = input[index];
    84	
    85	#pragma unroll
    86	                for (Index z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
    87	                    const Real left = input[index - 1];
    88	                    const Real right = input[index + 1];
    89	                    const Real front = input[index - nx];
    90	                    const Real back = input[index + nx];
    91	                    const Real top = input[index + planeStride];
    92	                    output[index] =
    93	                        (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) /
    94	                        7.0;
    95	                    bottom = center;
    96	                    center = top;
    97	                    index += planeStride;
    98	                }
    99	            }
   100	        }
   101	    }
   102	}
   103	
   104	struct GraphRun {
   105	    cudaGraph_t graph = nullptr;
   106	    cudaGraphExec_t executable = nullptr;
   107	    Real* finalGrid = nullptr;
   108	};
   109	
   110	template <typename Index, int BlockY, int ZChunk>
   111	GraphRun captureStencilGraph(Real* grid1, Real* grid2, const size_t nx,
   112	                             const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
   113	                             const int iterations,
   114	                             const cudaDeviceProp& deviceProperties,
   115	                             const cudaStream_t stream) {
   116	    const size_t requestedBlocksX =
   117	        (nx - 2 + static_cast<size_t>(kBlockX) - 1) / kBlockX;
   118	    const size_t requestedBlocksY =
   119	        (ny - 2 + static_cast<size_t>(BlockY) - 1) / BlockY;
   120	    const size_t requestedBlocksZ =
   121	        (nz - 2 + static_cast<size_t>(ZChunk) - 1) / ZChunk;
   122	    const unsigned int blocksX = static_cast<unsigned int>(std::min<size_t>(
   123	        requestedBlocksX, deviceProperties.maxGridSize[0]));
   124	    const unsigned int blocksY = static_cast<unsigned int>(std::min<size_t>(
   125	        requestedBlocksY, deviceProperties.maxGridSize[1]));
   126	    const unsigned int blocksZ = static_cast<unsigned int>(std::min<size_t>(
   127	        requestedBlocksZ, deviceProperties.maxGridSize[2]));
   128	    const dim3 block(kBlockX, BlockY);
   129	    const dim3 grid(blocksX, blocksY, blocksZ);
   130	    const Index kernelNx = static_cast<Index>(nx);
   131	    const Index kernelNy = static_cast<Index>(ny);
   132	    const Index kernelNz = static_cast<Index>(nz);
   133	
   134	    GraphRun run;
   135	    Real* input = grid1;
   136	    Real* output = grid2;
   137	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamBeginCapture(stream, cudaStreamCaptureModeGlobal));
   138	    for (int iteration = 0; iteration < iterations; ++iteration) {
   139	        stencilKernel<Index, BlockY, ZChunk><<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(
   140	            input, output, kernelNx, kernelNy, kernelNz);
   141	        std::swap(input, output);
   142	    }
   143	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   144	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamEndCapture(stream, &run.graph));
   145	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGraphInstantiate(&run.executable, run.graph, nullptr,
   146	                                    nullptr, 0));
   147	    run.finalGrid = input;
   148	    return run;
   149	}
   150	
   151	bool validateResult(const std::vector<Real>& grid) {
   152	    for (const Real value : grid) {
   153	        if (std::isnan(value) || std::isinf(value)) {
   154	            std::printf("Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value\n");
   155	            return false;
   156	        }
   157	    }
   158	
   159	    const auto bounds = std::minmax_element(grid.begin(), grid.end());
   160	    std::printf("Value range: [%.6f, %.6f]\n", *bounds.first, *bounds.second);
   161	    if (*bounds.second > 1e6 || *bounds.first < -1e6) {
   162	        std::printf("Validation failed: values out of expected range\n");
   163	        return false;
   164	    }
   165	    return true;
   166	}

   170	    std::printf("Options:\n");
   235	    const size_t gridBytes = gridSize * sizeof(Real);

   241

   243	    cudaDeviceProp deviceProperties{};

   245	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&deviceProperties, device));
   246

   248	    Real* deviceGrid2 = nullptr;

   250	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&deviceGrid2, gridBytes));
   251	
   252	    std::printf("Initializing grid...\n");
   253	    const size_t requiredInitBlocks =
   254	        (gridSize + kInitThreads - 1) / kInitThreads;
   255	    const size_t usefulInitBlocks =
   256	        static_cast<size_t>(deviceProperties.multiProcessorCount) * 32;
   257	    const unsigned int initBlocks = static_cast<unsigned int>(std::min(
   258	        {requiredInitBlocks, usefulInitBlocks,
   259	         static_cast<size_t>(deviceProperties.maxGridSize[0])}));
   260	    initializeGrids<<<initBlocks, kInitThreads>>>(deviceGrid1, deviceGrid2,
   261	                                                  gridSize);
   262	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   263	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
   264	
   265	    std::printf("Running stencil computation...\n");
   266	    cudaStream_t stream = nullptr;
   267	    cudaEvent_t startEvent = nullptr;
   268	    cudaEvent_t stopEvent = nullptr;
   269	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&stream, cudaStreamNonBlocking));
   270	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreate(&startEvent));
   271	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreate(&stopEvent));
   272	
   273	    GraphRun run;
   274	    run.finalGrid = deviceGrid1;
   275	    const size_t interiorCells =
   276	        (nx - 2) * static_cast<size_t>(ny - 2) * static_cast<size_t>(nz - 2);
   277	    if (interiorCells != 0 && iterations != 0) {
   278	        if (gridSize <= std::numeric_limits<unsigned int>::max()) {
   279	            if (interiorCells < kLargeGridThreshold) {
   280	                run = captureStencilGraph<unsigned int, 2, 1>(
   281	                    deviceGrid1, deviceGrid2, nx, ny, nz, iterations,
   282	                    deviceProperties, stream);
   283	            } else {
   284	                run = captureStencilGraph<unsigned int, 4, 8>(
   285	                    deviceGrid1, deviceGrid2, nx, ny, nz, iterations,
   286	                    deviceProperties, stream);
   287	            }
   288	        } else {
   289	            run = captureStencilGraph<size_t, 4, 8>(
   290	                deviceGrid1, deviceGrid2, nx, ny, nz, iterations,
   291	                deviceProperties, stream);
   292	        }
   293	    }
   294	
   295	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(startEvent, stream));
   296	    if (run.executable != nullptr) {
   297	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGraphLaunch(run.executable, stream));
   298	    }
   299	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(stopEvent, stream));
   300	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(stopEvent));
   301	    float elapsedMilliseconds = 0.0F;
   302	    CUDA_CHECK(
   303	        cudaEventElapsedTime(&elapsedMilliseconds, startEvent, stopEvent));
   304	
   305	    std::printf("Computation time: %.3f ms\n", elapsedMilliseconds);
   306	    const double cellUpdates = static_cast<double>(nx - 2) *
   307	                               static_cast<double>(ny - 2) *
   308	                               static_cast<double>(nz - 2) * iterations;
   309	    const double elapsedSeconds = elapsedMilliseconds / 1000.0;
   310	    const double mcups =
   311	        elapsedSeconds > 0.0 ? cellUpdates / elapsedSeconds / 1e6 : 0.0;
   312	    std::printf("Performance: %.3f MCellUpdates/s\n", mcups);
   313	
   314	    std::vector<Real> finalGrid;
   315	    if (printResults || validate) {
   316	        finalGrid.resize(gridSize);
   317	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(finalGrid.data(), run.finalGrid, gridBytes,
   318	                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
   319	    }
   320	
   321	    if (printResults) {
   322	        print_results(finalGrid, "Grid");
   323	    }
   324	
   325	    bool valid = true;
   326	    if (validate) {
   327	        std::printf("Validating result...\n");
   328	        valid = validateResult(finalGrid);
   329	        std::printf("Validation: %s\n", valid ? "PASSED" : "FAILED");
   330	    }
   331	
   332	    if (run.executable != nullptr) {
   333	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGraphExecDestroy(run.executable));
   334	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGraphDestroy(run.graph));
   335	    }
   336	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(startEvent));
   337	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(stopEvent));
   338	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(stream));
   339	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceGrid1));
   340	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceGrid2));
   341	    return valid ? 0 : 1;
   342	}

+// X is mapped to complete warps for fully coalesced access.  On large grids a
+// thread advances through a short Z run, retaining bottom and centre in
+// registers.  The cache hierarchy supplies the overlapping X/Y reads more
+// cheaply than an explicitly synchronized shared-memory tile on modern GPUs.
+template <typename Index, int BlockY, int ZChunk>
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * BlockY, 8)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output, const Index nx, const Index ny,
+                   const Index nz) {
+    const Index xGridStride = static_cast<Index>(gridDim.x) * kBlockX;
+    const Index yGridStride = static_cast<Index>(gridDim.y) * BlockY;
+    const Index zGridStride = static_cast<Index>(gridDim.z) * ZChunk;
+

+         xBase < nx - 1; xBase += xGridStride) {
+        const Index x = xBase + static_cast<Index>(threadIdx.x);
+        if (x >= nx - 1) continue;
+
+        for (Index yBase = static_cast<Index>(blockIdx.y) * BlockY + 1;
+             yBase < ny - 1; yBase += yGridStride) {
+            const Index y = yBase + static_cast<Index>(threadIdx.y);

Implemented an unconditional CUDA version while preserving the `stencil3d` executable name.

Key changes:

- Added coalesced CUDA stencil kernels with register-based Z reuse and adaptive launch geometry.
- Added CUDA Graph execution to reduce iteration launch overhead.
- Kept boundary semantics and double-buffer behavior exactly equivalent.
- Added GPU initialization, overflow checks, CUDA error handling, and event-based timing.
- Updated [CMakeLists.txt](/home/llmtest/evals/20260805-120633/stencil3d_gpt-5.6-sol-xhigh_cuda_r2/stencil3d/CMakeLists.txt:1) for native CUDA compilation.
- Main implementation is in [stencil3d.cpp](/home/llmtest/evals/20260805-120633/stencil3d_gpt-5.6-sol-xhigh_cuda_r2/stencil3d/stencil3d.cpp:39).

Verification:

- Clean CMake build succeeded.
- Exact CPU/GPU hashes matched across zero, odd/even, partial-tile, boundary-only, default, and large-grid cases.
- `128³ × 10` validation passed.
- RTX 3090 performance: approximately `1.21 ms` and `16.5 billion cell updates/s`, versus roughly `40 ms` for the original CPU implementation.

+// X is mapped to complete warps for fully coalesced access.  On large grids a
+// thread advances through a short Z run, retaining bottom and centre in
+// registers.  The cache hierarchy supplies the overlapping X/Y reads more
+// cheaply than an explicitly synchronized shared-memory tile on modern GPUs.
+template <typename Index, int BlockY, int ZChunk>
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * BlockY, 8)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output, const Index nx, const Index ny,
+                   const Index nz) {
+    const Index xGridStride = static_cast<Index>(gridDim.x) * kBlockX;
+    const Index yGridStride = static_cast<Index>(gridDim.y) * BlockY;
+    const Index zGridStride = static_cast<Index>(gridDim.z) * ZChunk;
+
+    for (Index xBase = static_cast<Index>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + 1;
+         xBase < nx - 1; xBase += xGridStride) {
+        const Index x = xBase + static_cast<Index>(threadIdx.x);
+        if (x >= nx - 1) continue;
+
+        for (Index yBase = static_cast<Index>(blockIdx.y) * BlockY + 1;
+             yBase < ny - 1; yBase += yGridStride) {
+            const Index y = yBase + static_cast<Index>(threadIdx.y);
+            if (y >= ny - 1) continue;
+
+            const Index planeStride = nx * ny;
+            for (Index zBegin =
+                     static_cast<Index>(blockIdx.z) * ZChunk + 1;
+                 zBegin < nz - 1; zBegin += zGridStride) {
+                const Index zEnd =
+                    min(zBegin + static_cast<Index>(ZChunk), nz - 1);
+                Index index = zBegin * planeStride + y * nx + x;
+                Real bottom = input[index - planeStride];
+                Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll
+                for (Index z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+                    const Real left = input[index - 1];
+                    const Real right = input[index + 1];
+                    const Real front = input[index - nx];
+                    const Real back = input[index + nx];
+                    const Real top = input[index + planeStride];
+                    output[index] =
+                        (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) /
+                        7.0;
+                    bottom = center;
+                    center = top;
+                    index += planeStride;
                 }
             }
         }
     }
 }
